jobs.title: Senior Product / System Quality & Verification Engineer
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Product / System Quality &amp; Verification Engineer--- Senior Product / System Quality \& Verification Engineer========================================================We are looking for a Senior Product / System Quality \& Verification Engineer to help establish and drive product quality from our first rideable prototypes through development and toward production.This is a hands\-on, cross\-functional individual contributor role at the intersection of product quality, systems integration, verification and reliability.You will work across mechanical, electrical, embedded software, connectivity and system interfaces. You are not expected to be the deepest technical expert in every domain—that responsibility remains with the respective Engineering teams. Instead, you will provide the independent quality perspective that connects these domains and ensures that the complete product is adequately verified, integrated, and ready for release.You will work closely with Mechanical Engineering, System Engineering, Embedded Software / Electronics, Product Management, suppliers and eventually Manufacturing and Service teams.**Key responsibilities**Plan, coordinate, and review verification and validation activities for components, subsystems, and complete e\-bike systems.Define and govern Minimum Test Requirements (MTRs) together with Engineering and suppliers, including appropriate test methods, conditions, sample sizes, and acceptance criteria.Review Supplier validation plans and test evidence, and challenge whether the proposed verification provides sufficient evidence that product requirements are met.Drive and coordinate system integration and end\-to\-end testing to ensure hardware, software, connectivity, and mobile app functions work reliably together.Own and maintain the FRACAS process, leading investigations into complex mechanical, electrical, software, and system\-level issues through root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, verification, and continuous learning.Define and coordinate reliability, durability, environmental, and field\-testing programs to identify risks and improve product robustness before launch.Coordinate homologation and certification testing, and release readiness reviews, ensuring compliance requirements are met and product quality is maintained throughout development.**What success looks like**Success in this role means that, as we move from prototypes toward production, we can confidently answer key questions about product readiness: What are the critical requirements? How are they being verified? Are the tests sufficiently rigorous? What issues have been found, and have the fixes been proven effective?You will ensure that verification activities, test results, product configurations, and compliance evidence are well structured, traceable, and visible, enabling informed decisions on product readiness, certification status, and release milestones.Success also means establishing a robust FRACAS and problem\-solving culture where issues are identified early, investigated systematically, resolved through verified corrective actions, and used to drive continuous improvement across products and processes.Ultimately, you will help build confidence that the complete e\-bike and it’s system is reliable, compliant, and ready for launch, not just at the component level but as an integrated product.Engineering teams will see Quality as a trusted partner that helps identify risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, and support successful product releases.**What you bring**5\+ years of experience in product quality, verification \& validation, reliability engineering, systems engineering, or a related discipline.Experience with complex mechatronic products such as e\-bikes, automotive systems, motorcycles, robotics, or consumer electronics.Strong understanding of verification, validation, reliability engineering, and structured problem\-solving methodologies such as FRACAS, 8D, or equivalent.A systems\-thinking mindset with the ability to work across mechanical, electrical, software, and connectivity domains, and understand how they interact in a complete product.Experience coordinating suppliers, validation activities, and complex system integration across multiple engineering disciplines.Ability to review and challenge test plans, Minimum Test Requirements, validation strategies, and technical evidence without needing to be the deepest subject matter expert in every domain.Comfortable working hands\-on with prototypes, test equipment, diagnostic tools, test data, and failure investigations.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Engineering, Product, Manufacturing, suppliers, and external test partners.Fluent English; or Swiss an advantage given the Switzerland base.![Viiala SA]()* Viiala SA  Route de Crassier 7  1262 Eysins*jid0d25577jm jit1146jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Join our purchasing team and help strengthen our global supply chain
jobs.employer: ZENITEL NORWAY AS AVD HOVEDKONTOR OSLO
jobs.description:
We are looking for a structured, proactive, and commercially minded Purchaser to join our procurement team. Workplace is Oslo or Horten.

As a Purchaser at Zenitel, you will play an important role in ensuring the timely and cost-effective supply of components, materials, and products that support our daily operations and long-term business objectives.

We are a global company operating in the electrical and electronics industry, working with suppliers and manufacturing partners both locally and internationally.

You will become part of a collaborative team where you will have the opportunity to take ownership of your responsibilities, contribute to continuous improvements, and develop your procurement expertise.

Key responsibilities:

  • Order placement and follow up

  • Manage end-to-end procurement processes, including RFQs, purchase orders, inventory management and contract negotiations

  • Keeping data on own products and suppliers in the ERP system updated

  • Assist in vendor selection and negotiation processes

  • Support sales organization/product management in sourcing activities for new products

  • Monitor inventory levels and collaborate with planning teams to forecast demand

  • Ensure timely delivery of components to support production schedules and project timelines

  • Analyze purchasing data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement

  • Collaborate closely with the procurement team and other departments with focus on operations and continuous improvements

Desired qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent within supply chain management, logistics, business administration, or a related field

  • Documented work experience within supply chain can compensate for formal education

  • Good commercial understanding and strong analytical skills

  • Good communication skills in English and preferably also in Norwegian

  • Experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 is an advantage, but not a requirement

We are looking for you whoare structured, proactive, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to manage multiple priorities. You have a commercial mindset, take initiative, and follow through on your tasks. You have strong communication skills, enjoy collaborating with colleagues and suppliers, approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset, and are motivated to learn and continuously improve.

We Offer:

  • An international working environment, with global suppliers and stakeholders

  • A varied role with responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact on our procurement operations

  • Opportunities for professional development and growth within purchasing and supply chain management

  • Close collaboration across departments and with international suppliers and partners

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • A collaborative and supportive working environment with skilled and dedicated colleagues

Come join our team!

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed throughout the recruitment process.

We conduct background checks on relevant candidates through Semac AS.

Zenitel wants to reflect the diversity of society, and encourages qualified candidates with different education, work and life experience to apply for a job with us without regard to ethnicity, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation and disability.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Zenitel is a major global player in the development and marketing of intelligent communication solutions where security, guaranteed availability and sound quality are essential. With 125 years of experience, Zenitel has proven to be a reliable and quality provider of broadcast systems, intercom solutions and two-way radio. These systems interface with other security devices, enabling end users and integrators to build a comprehensive and integrated security solution that combines access control, video surveillance, digital messaging and other solutions. Today, Zenitel's customers include security services providers, companies and organisations active in the transportation and shipping sectors, healthcare institutions and industrial companies. Zenitel employs approximately 460 people worldwide. Our headquarters are placed in Norway and UK, with 16 offices worldwide, as well as partners in more than 100 countries.

jobs.description: About Us:Rauland Skisenter AS is one of Telemark's largest tourism companies and among the larger ski resorts in Norway. We are dedicated to creating great skiing experiences for the whole family in a snow-reliable mountain destination.Rauland is located in the municipality of Vinje, an area with a long tradition of tourism and hospitality. Rauland town center offers a wide range of shops, restaurants, and services. Our operations are based at Vierli, Tiur, and Holtardalen.Our employees are our most valuable resource. During the high season, we employ nearly 100 staff members of all ages and from many different countries. We operate year-round, with business activities including skiing, accommodation, housekeeping, and food service. Rauland Skisenter is also certified as an Miljøfyrtårn company, demonstrating our commitment to environmental sustainability. Learn more about us at raulandskisenter.no.About the Position:We are looking for Lift Operators for the 2026/2027 winter season. Previous experience from other ski resorts is an advantage but not required, as full training will be provided. jobs.title: IAM-tekniker: se till att rätt person har rätt behörighet, varje dag
jobs.description: Det är tidig morgon och handläggare runt om i landet loggar in för att ta tag i dagens ärenden. De tänker inte på hur det går till, och det är precis så det ska vara. Bakom den smidiga inloggningen finns någon som ser till att identiteter stämmer, behörigheter sitter rätt och att allt fungerar även när något krånglar. Den personen skulle kunna vara du.Vi söker nu en IAM-tekniker till Digitaliserings- och utvecklingsavdelningen. Har du den tekniska kompetens och de personliga egenskaper vi söker? Då erbjuder vi ett omväxlande och ansvarsfullt arbete i en samhällsviktig verksamhet, med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, engagerade kollegor och tekniska utmaningar inom ett kritiskt område.Som medarbetare på Migrationsverket kan du förvänta dig ett givande arbete i en dynamisk miljö som präglas av samarbete, kontinuerliga förbättringar och respekt för människan. Hos oss bidrar du till samhällsnyttan samtidigt som du får en trygg och stabil anställning.Läs mer om att arbeta med IT hos oss: Jobba med IT – MigrationsverketHuvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterVi söker en IAM-tekniker som vill arbeta operativt med utveckling, konfigurering och drift av myndighetens identitetslösningar. Rollen är central för att säkerställa att rätt person har rätt behörighet vid rätt tidpunkt, med högt ställda krav på säkerhet och tillgänglighet. Du arbetar i team tillsammans med andra specialister och tekniker inom IAM-området.Dina arbetsuppgifter innebär bland annat att:    utveckla, konfigurera och förvalta IAM-lösningar baserade på autentiserings- och auktoriseringsprotokoll som OAuth 2.0/2.1, OIDC och SAML 2.0    driftsätta, förbättra och säkerställa stabil drift i myndighetens IAM-plattformar    bistå teamen vid nya driftsättningar    sätta upp, konfigurera och underhålla federationer, både internt och mot externa myndigheter och samarbetspartners    utföra felsökning, logganalys och incidenthantering i produktionsmiljö    övervaka prestanda, tillgänglighet och säkerhet i IAM-relaterade tjänsterDu samarbetar med roller som:    IAM-specialister och tekniker    utvecklingsteam    IT- och verksamhetsarkitekter    IT-säkerhetsfunktion    verksamhetsrepresentanterDu samarbetar nära dessa funktioner och deltar kontinuerligt i dialog kring tekniska lösningar och förbättringar. Du kommunicerar komplexa tekniska frågeställningar tydligt och strukturerat och trivs i en roll där samarbete och kvalitet är avgörande.Vem är du?Du är analytisk, strukturerad och trygg i din tekniska kompetens. Du trivs i komplexa miljöer där noggrannhet, säkerhet och stabilitet är centrala. Du tar ansvar, är lösningsorienterad och bidrar aktivt till teamets gemensamma utveckling.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. God samarbetsförmåga, ansvarstagande och gott omdöme i komplexa tekniska miljöer är centralt. Som statstjänsteman förväntas du dessutom ha ett högt omdöme samt en hög säkerhets- och sekretessmedvetenhet.Du som söker har:    Erfarenhet av arbete med identity providers och autentiserings- och auktoriseringsprotokoll    Produktionserfarenhet av konfiguration och drift av IAM-lösningar    Erfarenhet av federationslösningar    Erfarenhet av felsökning, logganalys och incidenthantering    God kommunikativ förmåga i tal och skrift    Svenskt medborgarskap (krav vid placering i säkerhetsklass)Det är också bra om du har:    Certifiering inom IT-säkerhet    Erfarenhet av Microsoft ADFS och/eller Keycloak    Erfarenhet av arbete inom myndighet eller annan säkerhetsklassad verksamhet    Erfarenhet av dokumentation och processutvecklingAnställningsvillkorTjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) genomförs innan beslut om anställning, och därför ställs krav på svenskt medborgarskap.    Placering: Tjänsten är placerad i Norrköping    Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning.    Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.    Arbetstid: Heltid, kontorstid med flextid.    Distansarbete: Möjlighet till visst distansarbete finns, utifrån verksamhetens behov och förutsättningar.    Lön: Individuell lönesättning baserad på ansvar, kompetens, erfarenhet och prestation.    Förmåner: Som medarbetare hos oss får du ta del av flera förmåner som bidrar till en god balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Läs mer under Förmåner och villkor – Migrationsverket.Så ansöker duVi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Sista ansökningsdag är 06 december 2026. Du ansöker via vårt rekryteringssystem.Vi har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet och ersätta det med urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Det gör det lättare att göra en objektiv bedömning av din kompetens. Du skickar in ditt CV som vanligt.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect, Nordics (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3+ years experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working
   
   

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale.

 - Fluency in additional languages

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €94,000-€105,000per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Full time
jobs.description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Engineer to work on the multi-agent pipeline turning raw, fragmented data into expert-grade real estate deliverables. You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Where We Operate

Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions, each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more.

The Role

You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do.

You can expect to:

  • Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows.

  • Own the system end to end: infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale.

  • Ensure production-grade quality, performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients.

  • Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations.

Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale.

  • Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times.

  • Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits.

  • Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display).

  • Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time.

What We're Looking For

  • 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance).

  • Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems.

  • Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs).

  • Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture).

  • Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning).

  • Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis.

  • Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase.

Nice to Have

  • Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production.

  • GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding).

  • Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules).

  • NLP background

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation.

  • Real-world impact: your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

  • High ownership: own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

  • A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: AI Researcher - Full time
jobs.description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Researcher to push the frontier of floorplan generation. Working directly with architects, you'll own research directions end-to-end, from diffusion and flow matching models (continuous and discrete) to deployment in a product used by real estate professionals.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Our Mission

We build a foundation model for architectural design that generates compliant, editable building layouts from scratch. By leveraging discrete diffusion models (operating on structured representations rather than pixels), we aim to produce floorplans and site plans that respect real-world constraints (zoning laws, space requirements, etc.) and can be iteratively refined like a human-designed plan.

The Role

We are looking for a AI Researcher to lead this effort in our Paris office. If you’re excited about improving our current state-of-the-art floorplan generative model and applying it to a high-impact domain, this role offers a unique opportunity to define a new class of AI-driven design tools. You will work within a focused team of 3–4 engineers and researchers, collaborating daily with architects to turn foundational research into deployable tools.

What you'll own:

  • Model Architecture & Design Space: Design the core model architecture and work on a discrete design space for architectural layouts. You will choose how to represent floorplans (e.g. as graphs of rooms/connections or token grids) such that the diffusion model’s outputs are editable and code-compliant by construction. This involves ensuring the model can enforce architectural rules (e.g. room sizes, adjacency constraints) within its generation process.

  • Large-Scale Model Training: Lead the training of a foundation diffusion model from scratch on GPU clusters. You’ll set up distributed training across multiple nodes, optimize data loading and checkpointing, and manage experiments at scale. The role requires hands-on engineering for efficient training of large models on high-performance computing infrastructure.

  • Benchmarking & Iteration: Evaluate the model’s performance and establish benchmarks to measure success. Using these evaluations, you’ll iterate on the model to push performance beyond existing methods. Our goal is to surpass the latest research results and produce genuinely useful architectural designs.

What We’re Looking For

  • Applied Research Excellence: PhD or Master’s in Maths, Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Strong foundations in ML and a track record of innovative research, publications, or high-impact projects.

  • Diffusion Model Expertise: Deep understanding of diffusion models (discrete or continuous), guided generation techniques, and the latest advances in generative modeling.

  • Large-Scale Model Training: Proven experience training large-scale deep learning models on GPU clusters. Comfortable with distributed training, multi-node jobs, experiment management, and handling large datasets.

  • Technical Engineering Skills: Proficiency in Python with experience in PyTorch or similar frameworks. Ability to write efficient, maintainable code and optimize training pipelines. Familiarity with distributed training libraries (e.g., PyTorch Lightning) is a plus.

  • Research Literacy: Ability to read, evaluate, and implement advanced ML research. You stay current with state-of-the-art generative modeling work and can adapt cutting-edge methods to domain-specific problems.

  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong teamwork skills. Able to articulate complex concepts clearly and work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and domain experts to integrate technical solutions into the architectural design workflow.

Nice to Have

  • Industry Experience: Background in a top AI research organization or cutting-edge startup, especially working on foundation models or generative AI tools.

  • Publications/Open Source: Research publications in generative modeling (diffusion, VAEs, flows, GANs) or significant open-source contributions demonstrating ability to push state-of-the-art systems.

  • Domain Knowledge: While not required, an interest in architecture or design will help.

  • Reinforcement Learning & Optimization: Experience with RL, reward modeling, or constrained optimization (particularly MCTS, GRPO and RLHF) relevant to guiding generative models under complex constraints.

  • Multimodal Generation: Experience with graph-based, sequence-based, or discrete structured generative models (e.g., molecule generation, layout generation, program synthesis) or with graph neural networks.

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 12 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Build what no one has before: the foundation model that automates architectural design and redefines how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

  • Work on meaningful challenges: from constraint-aware generative models to real-world deployment in major construction projects.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

  • Ship fast, iterate boldly: go from research to prototype to production in weeks, not years.

  • Join a world-class team: a mix of AI researchers, engineers, and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

jobs.title: Projectleider Gebiedsontwikkeling
jobs.description:
Als projectleider gebiedsontwikkeling bij Waalpartners speel je een cruciale rol in het realiseren van de nieuwbouwopgaven van onze opdrachtgevers. Jij bewaart het overzicht, staat naast de opdrachtgever en draagt bij aan oplossingen voor de uitdagingen die woningbouw met zich meebrengt. Zo hebben we recentelijk meegedacht voor de nieuwe woonomgeving ‘Vlijweide’ in Dordrecht. Bij deze locatie ontwikkeling komt nogal wat bij elkaar. Water, bodem, ecologie, een primaire waterkering én verschillende partijen met ieder hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid en expertise. En dat alles om een toekomstbestendig nieuw woongebied te ontwikkelen.

Dit ga je doen

Met je brede kennis en jarenlange ervaring sta je stevig in een dynamische projectomgeving. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie.

Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt.

Dit ben jij

Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen. Je omgeving ziet je als collegiaal en je neemt verantwoordelijkheid over je project en de ontwikkeling van de projectteamleden.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 – €6.900 bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

  • Groeipad. Met onze Waalacademy bouw je stevig aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • Flexibele werktijden. Kom je liever om half 8 binnen, in plaats van half 9? Geen probleem.

  • Hybride werken. We zien je graag op kantoor, omdat we veel met elkaar en onze opdrachtgevers overleggen en samenwerken. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om thuis te werken, daarom mag je 2 dagen per week vanuit huis werken (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband).

  • 27 vakantiedagen

  • Resultaatafhankelijke winstdeling. Draaien we samen een goed jaar? Dan profiteer jij daar ook van!

  • Een goede pensioenregeling onder het oude pensioenstelsel.

  • Een elektrische auto van de zaak, die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Plezier. We werken niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van onze omgeving en onszelf, maar hebben ‘t ook leuk met elkaar. Onze personeelsvereniging organiseert regelmatig activiteiten, we gaan samen op citytrip of een paar kilometer hardlopen.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Je hebt de drive om een project voor alle belanghebbenden tot een goed einde te brengen.

  • Jij vindt het belangrijk om jezelf, samen met je collega’s, te blijven ontwikkelen.

  • Je hebt een civieltechnische opleiding (hbo werk- en denkniveau).

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt jezelf goed verwoorden: In gesprek en op papier.

  • Je hebt de ervaring om complexe projecten te doorzien en te begeleiden.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor thema’s als binnenstedelijke herinrichting, klimaatadaptatie of geotechniek.

jobs.title: Bra Innovation Designer
jobs.description:
Summary: Overall Job Purpose

As a Bra Innovation Designer, you will lead the creative development of innovative bra products across our lingerie collections, with a particular focus on moulded cup technologies, new constructions, materials and functional design solutions.

You will combine a strong fashion sensibility with specialist knowledge of bra design, translating customer needs, market insights and emerging textile technologies into commercially relevant products that deliver CHANGE's Perfect Fit philosophy.

Working across our two annual fashion collections and ongoing product development initiatives, you will drive new product concepts from initial research and design through prototyping, sample development and production readiness. You will collaborate closely with Technical Design, Production, Planning and our manufacturing partners in China to develop products that balance innovation, aesthetics, comfort, support, quality and commercial viability.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

·         Research emerging trends, bra innovations, competitor products, textile technologies and customer needs to identify new product development opportunities.

·         Lead the design and development of innovative bra concepts, including moulded cup bras, seamless and bonded constructions, wireless solutions and new support technologies.

·         Explore moulding techniques, foam and spacer materials, cup shapes, pad and wire solutions, innovative fabrics, elastics and construction methods in collaboration with Technical Design, Production and suppliers.

·         Develop new silhouettes and design solutions that enhance fit, comfort, support and aesthetics across CHANGE’s extensive size range, including larger cup sizes.

·         Create detailed design sketches, technical drawings, concept presentations and collection overviews using Adobe Creative Suite.

·         Initiate raw material research, sourcing and development with suppliers, including new material technologies and alternative sourcing opportunities.

·         Work closely with Technical Design on prototype fittings, construction development, material performance and product refinement, supporting the achievement of approved fit and quality standards.

·         Collaborate with manufacturing partners in China to develop prototypes, evaluate new manufacturing capabilities and translate innovative concepts into commercially viable products.

·         Assess target costs, manufacturing feasibility and design-to-cost opportunities to achieve category margin objectives.

·         Create and maintain accurate design information in PLM, including sketches, materials, trims, colorways, design BOM components and development updates.

·         Support product commercialization through product descriptions, key product features, innovation storytelling and collaboration with Marketing.

·         Contribute to continuous improvement of bra design standards, product performance and the development of new product categories.

KPIs

·         On-Time Milestone Delivery: Percentage of assigned design and innovation deliverables completed within agreed collection deadlines.

·         Product Innovation: Delivery of approved new bra concepts, moulded cup solutions, materials and construction innovations against agreed development objectives.

·         First-Time Sample Accuracy: Percentage of initial samples meeting approved design specifications without significant aesthetic or construction-related design corrections.

·         Design Cost Compliance: Percentage of developed styles meeting target FOB costs and category margin objectives.

·         PLM Data Accuracy & Completeness

·         Commercial Performance: Performance of launched innovation products against agreed sales, sell-through and category objectives.

Ideal Profile

You are an experienced and technically curious designer with a genuine passion for lingerie, product innovation and the relationship between design, fit and function.

You bring specialist knowledge of bra construction and moulded cup products, together with a strong understanding of textile materials, manufacturing processes and emerging technologies. You enjoy exploring new solutions, challenging existing product constructions and translating complex technical possibilities into desirable, commercially relevant designs.

jobs.title: PhD-fellowship
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applicants for a full-time position as a PhD research fellow at the Department of Psychology, Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Oslo. The position is associated with the Personality unit at the Section for Health, Developmental, and Personality Psychology (HUP). The PhD will focus on development of personality and depression across the lifespan, and will be connected to The Depression Research Initiative (DRIVE) at the Department of Psychology. 

The appointment is a fulltime position for a period of three years. The employment period can be up to 4 years given addition of teaching and administrative duties, depending on the competence of the successful applicant and the resources and needs of the Department of Psychology.

Start date: Spring 2027.

More about the position

The PhD candidate will be part of the Personality group and focus on the relationship between personality, depression, and other mental health conditions. Personality is important for the development and course of mental health problems, and may affect how environmental risk factors affect mental health, as well as the consequences of mental health problems for social and academic functioning. The PhD project will be part of The Depression Research Initiative (DRIVE), made up by five work packages https://www.sv.uio.no/psi/english/research/groups/drive/index.html. 

The key objective of DRIVE is to encompass several core aspects of depression research, so they collectively can address questions that cannot be managed by a single work package. The current position will be related to the work package focusing on development of depression. The PhD project will answer some of the following overarching research questions, with a focus on depression: 

  • How do characteristics of the individual and the environment predict personality development?
  • What are the associations between personality traits and mental health outcomes, including depression, personal relationships, and work and academic functioning?
  • What are the associations between characteristics of parents and children regarding personality and mental health, including depression?
Your main tasks will be
  • Contributing to developing more specific research questions within the project.
  • Complete a PhD thesis in Psychology.
  • Publish research papers in international scientific journals.
  • Provide scientific presentations to an international audience.
  • Participate in the PhD program at the Department of Psychology.
Qualifications

Required skills

  • At the time of the application, the applicants must have obtained a Cand. Psychol. degree, or a Master’s degree in psychology or a closely related field.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English are required.
  • Experience in conducting statistical analyses.
  • A strong interest in the topic of the PhD position.
  • Interest in finding and reading relevant literature, defining research questions, preparing and analyzing data, and writing manuscripts.

To be employed as a PhD Research Fellow at the Department of Psychology, applicants must meet the admission requirements for the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences, with specialisation in Psychology. The successful candidate will be admitted to this programme option, subject to approval of the individual project proposal. Please see the Faculty’s admission requirements and the structure of the Psychology programme option.

Preferred skills

  • Experience with running statistical analyses in R.
  • Knowledge of personality, developmental psychology, and/or depression.
  • Good writtenand oral proficiency inNorwegian.
  • Experience with analyzing longitudinal data.
  • Experience with conducting literature reviews.
  • Previous research and interest in the above-mentioned topics. 
  • Proven ability to work independently and efficiently on relevant research topics.
Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and to collaborate effectively with others.
  • Curiosity and interest in learning.
  • Strong motivation and organizational skills. 
  • Ability to think creatively within a scientific framework. 

Employment in the position is basedon a comprehensive assessment of allqualification requirements applicable tothe position, including personal qualifications.

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 

Why should you choose us?
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK 565 700–625 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application should include:

  • An application letter including your motivation for the job and a description of how your qualifications are relevant for the job. 
  • CV
  • A complete list of publications
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • Contact information for 2-3 references

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Psychology is one of seven units of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and has 75 permanent and 70 temporary members of scientific staff. Degrees are offered at bachelor and master level, plus a clinical training programme, and the PhD programme has 140 students.

jobs.title: DGI Storkøbenhavn søger idrætskonsulent til gymnastik (barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del af en organisation, som går forrest i udviklingen af idrætsforeninger?

Har du en faglighed inden for gymnastik og et stærkt foreningskendskab? 

Brænder du for at sammensætte og drive de helt rigtige kurser og uddannelser?

Så er du måske vores nye kollega i DGI Storkøbenhavn.

Vi søger en konsulent, som kan arbejde strategisk og er en drivkraft i udviklingen af gymnastikken i Storkøbenhavn. Med udgangspunkt i din faglige viden og erfaring skal du samarbejde med gymnastikforeningerne om udvikling, aktiviteter og uddannelse af instruktører og ledere.Du understøtter gymnastikforeningerne i deres dagligdag og er deres sparringspartner og rådgiver. Du skal derfor kunne skabe gode relationer til nøglepersoner i gymnastikforeningerne samtidig med, at du kan inddrage kolleger med forskellige andre fagligheder. 

Det er især vigtigt, at du kan drive og udvikle vores kursus- og uddannelsesområde, så vores tilbud til gymnastikforeninger, frivillige og instruktører er attraktive og af høj kvalitet. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at

  • løbende kvalificere vores udbud af kurser og uddannelser
  • afdække behov hos foreninger og omsætte dem til relevante tilbud
  • udvikle nye kurser, uddannelser og skræddersyede forløb
  • rekruttere de rette undervisere og samarbejde tæt med dem
  • arbejde med synlighed og øge deltagelsen på vores kurser

DGI Storkøbenhavn har desuden indgået en række kommunepartnerskaber med henblik på at skabe de bedste forudsætninger for foreningsidrætten lokalt. I den forbindelse samarbejder vi med stærke og toneangivende foreninger om deres specifikke udfordringer og potentialer. En del af de foreninger er gymnastikforeninger, hvorfor du får en central rolle i disse udviklingsprocesser. 

Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab i DGI Storkøbenhavns idrætsteam og vil også arbejde sammen med administrative medarbejdere og foreningskonsulenter.  

Din profil:

  • Faglig viden om gymnastik og ambitioner for udvikling af idrætten
  • Et skarpt blik for både udvikling og udbredelse af kurser og uddannelser
  • Erfaring som konsulent eller projektleder – du ved, hvordan man skaber fremdrift og resultater
  • Erfaring med foreningsudvikling og gerne kendskab til gymnastikforeningerne i Storkøbenhavn
  • En udadvendt og opsøgende tilgang – du trives med at skabe relationer og netværk
  • Kompetent bruger af administrative systemer

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt. Tiltrædelse 1. februar 2027. 

Det er en tidsbegrænset stilling med udløb 31. marts 2028.

Aften- og weekendarbejde vil forekomme. 

 

DGI Storkøbenhavn

Som idrætsforeningernes udviklingshus styrker vi idrætsforeningerne i en by i konstant forandring. Vi dækker 11 kommuner og repræsenterer ca. 650 idrætsforeninger, der samlet set har mere end 300.000 medlemmer. Vi oplever vækst i medlemstal og samarbejder tæt med foreninger og kommuner om de lokale udviklingsmuligheder.

Vi tilbyder et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø med ca. 55 passionerede medarbejdere og mange frivillige. Kontoret ligger i moderne lokaler centralt i København på Vesterbrogade lige overfor Hovedbanegården.

 

Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfrist er onsdag den 2. december.

Vi holder samtaler mandag den 7. december og anden samtaler torsdag den 10. december.

jobs.description:
Hvem er jeg?

Jeg er en livsglad og hyggelig dame på 61 år som bor i en tilrettelagt bolig, og jeg trenger deg som vil bidra til at jeg kan leve et aktivt og meningsfullt liv også når mine faste assistenter er utilgjengelige. Jeg sitter i rullestol, men det er ingen hindring for å oppleve mye spennende! Jeg elsker å gå turer, trene, og ikke minst ha gode samtaler. Har du sans for håndarbeid og hage, er det et stort pluss – da har vi enda mer å snakke om!

Hvem er du og hva skal du gjøre?

Jeg søker deg som er interessert i å jobbe når mine faste assistenter har ferie, er syke eller i perioder hvor jeg har ekstra behov for assistanse. Det er sentralt at du kan stille opp på kort varsel og at du er en person jeg kan stole på over tid. Du liker å jobbe med mennesker, har et smittende godt humør, og er pliktoppfyllende og tålmodig. Kan du i tillegg se hva som må gjøres uten at jeg må spørre, er du den perfekte match!

Du vil få en variert hverdag der du bidrar med alt fra personlig hygiene og tilberedning av frokost/lunsj/middag, til husarbeid, handling og assistanse under trening. Det kan også bli en tur på teater eller handling i Sverige!

Vi har gode hjelpemidler på plass, så det er ingen tunge løft. Ellers blir dette dine arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Assistere til og fra sosiale tilsetninger, teater o.l.

  • Hjelpe med personlig hygiene

  • Hjelpe til ved frokost/lunsj og lage middag

  • Hjelpe med husarbeid

  • Assistere ved handling eller andre praktiske gjøremål

  • Assistere under trening

Hva ønskes av deg?

  • Du har førerkort klasse B

  • Du har dokumenterte norskkunnskaper på minimum nivå B1

  • Du har godt humør og er samarbeidsvillig, men også selvstendig

  • Du kan stille på kort varsel og er innstilt på å være en ressurs over tid. Kan du jobbe i ferier eller ved høytider er det også en fordel.

  • Tobakksfri arbeidsplass

  • Basert på arbeidets art ønsker jeg kvinner

Om stillingen og arbeidstid

  • Stillingstype: Tilkalling - og ferievikar, med mulighet for mye jobb i perioder

  • Arbeidstid er hovedsakelig hverdager og helg fra 08.00-16.00, men det kan også være behov på kveld

  • Reiser kan forekomme.

Jeg verdsetter mangfold og oppfordrer alle som kjenner seg igjen i beskrivelsen til å søke.

For mer informasjon om stillingen:

Eva H. Haugen | BPA-rådgiver

+47 95 04 30 00

eva.haugen@humananorge.no

Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Store Manager Odense
jobs.employer: Ria Financial Services DENMARK, ApS - DK7000
jobs.description:
Description

Ria Money Transfer, a business segment of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT), delivers innovative financial services including fast, secure, and affordable global money transfers to millions of customers along with currency exchange, mobile top-up, bill payment and check cashing services, offering a reliable omnichannel experience.  With over 600,000 locations in nearly 200 countries and territories, our purpose remains to open ways for a better everyday life.

 

We believe we can create a world in which people are empowered to build the life they dream of, no matter who they are or where they are. One customer, one family, one community at a time.

About this role

Ria Financial Services Denmark  is looking for a driven and service‑oriented professional for the role of Store Manager. We are a global leader in money transfers and currency exchange, with an extensive network of our own offices and branches.This is a full‑time position located in Odense. As a Store Manager, you will play a key role in supporting daily store operations and leading the team toward achieving sales targets and performance goals. You will help ensure an outstanding customer experience while actively supporting the store in reaching its business objectives and maintaining high operational standards.

 

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily store operations to ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.Supervise, support, and coach store staff to maintain high service and sales standards.Monitor sales performance, service quality, and operational efficiency.Ensure accurate cash management, reconciliation, and reporting, with overall accountability for store compliance.Support staff scheduling and coverage planningprovide occasional operational support during peak periods if required.

 WE ARE LOOKING FOR YOU WHOHas experience in retail, financial services, or customer service, preferably in a supervisory or senior role.Is fluent in Danish and English, with proficiency in a third language.Demonstrates strong leadership, organizational, and decision‑making skills.Is structured, responsible, and comfortable handling operational accountability.Has experience with cash handling and compliance-controlled environments (meritorious).Comfortable using standard office software, including Word and Excel.

 

Perks & Benefits

A leadership role in a stable, international financial services company.Opportunity to develop supervisory and operational management skills.A diverse, inclusive, and multicultural working environment.

 

Ria Money Transfer is an equal opportunity employer.  We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

 

Check out our website to learn more about the company at: http://www.riamoneytransfer.com/

jobs.title: Lagermedarbejder søges til fuldtidsvikariat i Roskilde – Hurtig opstart
jobs.description:
FIRMAVIKAR søger en stabil og arbejdsom lagermedarbejder til en af vores kunder i Roskilde. Har du erfaring med lagerarbejde, og trives du med praktiske opgaver i en travl hverdag? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig.

Der er tale om et fuldtidsvikariat på 37 timer om ugen med opstart hurtigst muligt. Vikariatet forventes at vare 3 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af et lager, hvor du primært skal arbejde med pluk og pak af varer. Du kommer til at arbejde sammen med virksomhedens lageransvarlige og skal være med til at sikre, at de daglige lageropgaver bliver løst effektivt og korrekt.

Vi søger en medarbejder, som kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for sine opgaver og bidrage til en velfungerende hverdag på lageret.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Plukning og pakning af varer

  • Klargøring af ordrer til forsendelse

  • Håndtering og organisering af varer

  • Oprydning og orden på lageret

  • Øvrige forefaldende lageropgaver

Vi forventer, at du

  • Gerne har erfaring med lagerarbejde, særligt pluk og pak

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og arbejdsom

  • Arbejder effektivt og har øje for detaljerne

  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

  • Har en positiv indstilling og er klar til at tage fat

  • Kan starte hurtigst muligt

Vi tilbyder

  • Et fuldtidsvikariat på 37 timer om ugen

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med en varieret arbejdsdag

  • Et vikariat på ca. 3 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse

  • En fast kontaktperson hos FIRMAVIKAR under hele forløbet

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: RoskildeOpstart: Mandag den 16. november 2026 eller hurtigst muligtArbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen, placeret i tidsrummet kl. 08.00–16.00, mandag til fredagAnsættelsesform: FuldtidsvikariatVarighed: Ca. 3 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@firmavikar.dk hurtigst muligt.

Skriv gerne "Lagermedarbejder – Roskilde" i emnefeltet.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

FIRMAVIKAR – Vikar & Rekruttering

jobs.title: Underviser til AI-kurser
jobs.description:
Vi søger en underviser til kurser i AI (kunstig intelligens) hos FOF Køge Bugt.

Vi laver aftenskolekurser i ni kommuner på Sjælland og Bornholm.

Brænder du for kunstig intelligens og for at gøre et komplekst emne forståeligt for helt almindelige mennesker? Så er du måske vores nye aftenskoleunderviser i AI.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en engageret og pædagogisk stærk underviser til at afholde et eller flere aftenskoleforløb om kunstig intelligens.

Kurserne henvender sig til voksne kursister med forskellige baggrunde, som ønsker at forstå og anvende AI i hverdagen. Emnerne kan spænde fra introduktion til AI, brug af værktøjer som ChatGPT, billedgenerering, dataetik og grundlæggende promptteknikker – alt efter din profil og kursisternes behov.

Dine opgaver

• Planlægge og gennemføre undervisningsforløb

• Præsentere AI-begreber på en letforståelig og praksisnær måde

• Udvikle øvelser og materiale, der understøtter aktiv læring

• Skabe et trygt og nysgerrigt læringsmiljø

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Har viden om og erfaring med AI-værktøjer

• Har undervisningserfaring eller generelt flair for formidling

• Er opdateret på aktuelle tendenser inden for AI

• Er selvstændig, struktureret og god til at møde kursister i øjenhøjde

• Ikke mindst har lyst til at inspirere og gøre teknologien tilgængelig for nye brugere

Vigtig viden:

• Du bliver timelønnet jf. Folkeoplysningsloven, og vi aftaler timerne sammen.

Kontakt os endelig, hvis følgende passer på dig – vi går op i personligheder, ikke formfuldendte ansøgninger:

En del af vores passionerede team

Som underviser hos FOF Køge Bugt får du en nøgleposition i vores arbejde, og du er med til at sikre, at vores kursister får den bedste oplevelse.

Vi tilbyder et spændende og givende job i en stærk virksomhed præget af samarbejde, fællesskab og utrættelig lyst til at tilbyde folkeoplysende undervisning for alle, uanset forudsætning.

Vores kursister kommer igen år efter år – både på grund af undervisningen og det varme fællesskab, der opstår, når man lærer noget sammen. Og vores undervisere har det på samme måde. Bare i år har vi fejret 10, 20, 25 og 30 års jubilæer mere end ti gange blandt vores undervisere.

Som underviser i FOF Køge Bugt ansættes du på timebasis, og aflønningen sker jf. folkeoplysningsloven. Lønnen beregnes i henhold til Undervisningsministeriets bekendtgørelse om løn- og ansættelsesvilkår for lærere ved undervisning mv. efter folkeoplysningsloven.

Er du interesseret?

Så send din ansøgning til fagkonsulent Maria Ditlev Rosenvinge på mdr@fof.dk. Du er også meget velkommen til at kontakte Maria på mail med spørgsmål, inden du søger.

Giv endelig også et praj, hvis du kender en der vil passe til stillingen

jobs.title: Underviser til kursus i slægsforskning i FOF Køge Bugt
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren slægtsforsker, der kan formidle slægtsforskning til vores nysgerrige kursister i Køge, Greve, Ishøj, Solrød, Stevns, Roskilde, Lejre, Egedal og Bornholms kommune.

Vores tidligere underviser er gået på pension, og derfor skal vi finde en ny. Vi opretter hold løbende og vælger tid og sted sammen med dig.

Vi søger en underviser, som:

  • Har gode kompetencer inden for slægtsforskning.

  • Har erfaring med at undervise voksne

  • Kan skabe en tryg og motiverende undervisning, hvor kursisterne føler sig velkomne

  • Er engageret, mødestabil og god til at skabe relationer

  • Har lyst til at være en del af et stærkt undervisningsfællesskab

Det vigtigste for os er ikke en bestemt uddannelsesmæssig baggrund, men at du har erfaring med slægtsforskning, og kan gøre undervisningen levende og inspirerende.

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • Hold med eksisterende kursister

  • Stor frihed til at tilrettelægge undervisningen

  • Mulighed for at oprette flere hold

  • Et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du gør en forskel for voksne kursisters læring og fællesskab

At være underviser hos FOF Køge Bugt

Hos FOF Køge Bugt bliver du en del af Danmarks bedste aftenskole. Vi tror på livslang læring, fællesskab og glæden ved at lære noget nyt.

Mange af vores undervisere har været hos os i mange år, og vi lægger vægt på et tæt samarbejde, hvor du altid kan få hjælp og sparring. Som underviser får du stor frihed til at sætte dit eget præg på undervisningen, samtidig med at du bliver en del af et engageret fællesskab af undervisere og medarbejdere.

Praktisk information

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende aftaler for aftenskoleundervisere, se folkeoplysningsloven.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, eller er du klar til at sende dit cv, så skriv til faglig leder Maria Ditlev Rosenvinge på mdr@fof.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – og du behøver ikke skrive den perfekte ansøgning. Fortæl os gerne lidt om dig selv, din erfaring med slægtsforskning og hvorfor du kunne tænke dig at undervise hos FOF Køge Bugt.

jobs.title: Team Lead Electrical Engineering (gn)
jobs.description:
Im Auftrag unseres Kunden Oerlikon Metco AG suchen wir eine:n Team Lead Electrical Engineering (gn)

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Fachliche und personelle Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung eines engagierten Elektroengineering-Teams
  • Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte und Evaluation neuer Komponenten und Technologien
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement, Produktion, Sales und weiteren Fachbereichen
  • Sicherstellung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Engineering-Standards, Prozessen und Qualitätsrichtlinien
  • Planung und Koordination von Ressourcen, Projekten und Engineering-Aktivitäten
  • Initiierung und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen im Rahmen des KVP

Ihr Profil

  • Solide technische Grundausbildung und Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF/FH (Elektrotechnik, Automation oder Systemtechnik)
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Elektro-Engineering sowie Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams
  • Fundiertes Fachwissen relevanter Normen, Sicherheitsstandards im Bereich der Elektrotechnik im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau
  • Profunde Kenntnisse in elektrischen CAD-Systemen (EPLAN P8, COMOS oder vergleichbaren Systemen)
  • Verständnis für Automatisierungs- und Robotik-Lösungen, Kenntnisse von ABB- oder FANUC-Systemen sind ein Plus
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit in Deutsch und Englisch im Umgang mit Kunden, sowie internen und externen Ansprechpartnern (gn)
  • Selbstständige, motivierte und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit

Wir bieten

  • Spannende Projekte in einem international ausgerichteten Unternehmen im High-Tech-Bereich
  • Offene Unternehmenskultur und ein freundliches, aufgeschlossenes Team
  • Ein modernes Produktions- und Technologiezentrum für Thermische Beschichtung ab 2027 in Hausen (AG)
  • Perspektiven zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten in einem attraktiven Arbeitsumfeld
  • Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen sowie fortschrittliche Sozialleistungen

Fühlen Sie sich angesprochen? Dann sind wir neugierig darauf, Sie kennen zu lernen!
Bewerben Sie sich bitte online über unsere Career-Seite.

Für diese Vakanz können Bewerbungen von Personalvermittlungen nicht berücksichtigt werden. Vielen Dank für Ihr Verständnis.

Über Oerlikon

Oerlikon ist weltweit führend in Material Science Engineering. Mit der richtigen Kombination aus Oberflächentechnologien, Advanced Materials, Beschichtungsanlagen, Komponenten und Advanced Manufacturing helfen wir Kunden, die Leistung, Effizienz, Langlebigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit ihrer Produkte und Prozesse zu verbessern. Unsere Technologien sind für Endnutzer oft unsichtbar, aber geschäftskritisch für die Branchen, die das moderne Leben ermöglichen: Luft- und Raumfahrt, Energie, Halbleiter, Medizintechnik, Luxusgüter, Werkzeugindustrie, Automobilindustrie und allgemeine Industrie. Oerlikon hat seinen Hauptsitz in Pfäffikon, Schweiz, ist in 38 Ländern tätig und beschäftigt weltweit rund 10.000 Mitarbeitende. Im Jahr 2025 erzielte Oerlikon einen Umsatz von CHF 1,6 Milliarden.

Wir bieten eine große Vielfalt an Tätigkeitsprofilen in einem dynamischen, unterstützenden Umfeld, in dem Menschen befähigt werden, zu wachsen und ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten – geleitet von unseren Kernwerten Integrität, Teamgeist, Exzellenz und Innovation.
