jobs.title: Personlig assistent till kvinna i Gröndal – nära heltid
jobs.description: Om Kurera AssistansKurera Assistans är ett ungt och modernt assistansbolag. Företaget är del av Kurera Omsorg som även innefattar Individ- och familj samt Rusta och Matcha. Kurera Assistans har kontor i Malmö, Västervik och Stockholm! För oss är våra medarbetare allt. Utan engagerade, kreativa och hjärtliga kollegor är vi ingenting. Därför tar vi varje rekrytering på största allvar och vill finnas där för vår personal under hela anställningen – med ärliga samtal, närvaro och ett genuint intresse för att alla ska trivas och utvecklas. När våra medarbetare mår bra, mår också våra kunder bra. Vi strävar alltid efter att arbeta med engagemang, ansvar, nytänkande och glädje. Vi vill göra skillnad på riktigt. Hos oss finns kollektivavtal, friskvård och närvarande chefer.  Vi hoppas att du vill bli en del av vårt team!Är du en trygg och omtänksam person som trivs med att arbeta nära andra människor? Vi söker nu en kvinnlig personlig assistent som vill bidra till en fungerande, aktiv och trygg vardag för en kvinna i 50-årsåldern som bor i Gröndal. Det här är en tjänst där din personlighet, ditt engagemang och din förmåga att samarbeta är minst lika viktiga som tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet.Vi tror att du passar hos oss om du har ett varmt och respektfullt bemötande och känner dig trygg i mötet med andra människor. Du är en person som kan behålla lugnet, även när situationer förändras, och som förstår värdet av tydlighet, tålamod och struktur. Vi ser gärna att du är social och positiv, men också lyhörd för när det behövs lugn och ro. Du tar ansvar, kan arbeta självständigt när det behövs och tycker om att samarbeta med kollegor.För tjänsten behöver du även:•    Vara rökfri och inte vara allergisk mot häst eller hund.•    Vara simkunnig.•    Ha mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt.•    Gärna vara i åldern 35–55 år.•    Se detta som din huvudsakliga sysselsättning.Har du arbetat som personlig assistent tidigare är det ett plus, men det är inget krav. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och söker framför allt någon som har ett genuint intresse för att hjälpa andra. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att bygga en nära och förtroendefull relation och vara delaktig i att skapa en bra vardag.Som anställd hos oss får du:•    Ett varierande och meningsfullt arbete.•    Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor.•    Marknadsmässig lön, tjänstepension och försäkringar samt friskvårdsbidrag.•    En arbetsgivare som värdesätter kvalitet, omtanke och engagemang.I kundens lägenhet finns även ett separat jourrum som används vid nattarbete.Omfattning: Nära heltid, med möjlighet till extrapass.Arbetstider: Varierande arbetstider under dag, kväll och natt, inklusive både aktiv natt och jour. Arbete förekommer på vardagar och helger.Arbetsplats: Gröndal, Stockholm.Tillträde: Snarast möjligt.Vi söker dig som vill ha ett arbete där du får använda både din omtanke och din förmåga att skapa struktur och trygghet. Hos oss blir du en viktig del av en annan människas vardag och av ett arbetslag där samarbete har stor betydelse. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan - vi ser fram emot att höra mer om dig!

jobs.title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

jobs.title: Senior Analytical Chemist - BRIGHT
jobs.description:
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT) at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) aims to accelerate the development of biosolutions and strengthen the bio-based economy. The Biofoundry is an important part of BRIGHT and ensures effective development and implementation of strain design procedures in our design-build-test-learn workflow using big data and data science. The Analytics team is part of the Biofoundry and is providing reliable, accurate and high-throughput analytical services by means of state-of-the-art analytical techniques. We are now seeking a skilled Senior Analytical Chemist to join the team in providing BRIGHT with professional analytical services. The jobAs a Senior Analytical Chemist you will be part of a dynamic international team where you will be supporting the on-going activities and projects. You will be working together with another Analytical Chemist on our GC-based platforms, and you will be reporting directly to the Head of Analytics. Your immediate responsibilities will be:
  • Independently taking responsibility for handling incoming requests and projects in accordance to existing priorities
  • Running existing GC-MS and GC-FID methods
  • Setting up workflows (sample preparation, method development and data processing) for new GC-based analyses
  • Handling and reporting experimental data in reports, lab notebooks and LIMS-systems
  • Writing and maintaining SOPs
  • Flexibly and proactively helping other team members within the Analytics Team
  • Daily maintenance and troubleshooting of GC-MS and GC-FID equipment
Our expectations of youWe are looking for a colleague who likes to create results via positive and efficient teamwork. As part of this, you must thrive in a multi-disciplinary, multi-cultural and highly interactive environment where knowledge sharing, and collaboration are keys to succeed. Additionally, your CV comprises:
  • PhD in analytical chemistry or similar
  • Experience in independently running assigned projects (requiring GC analyses) from the planning phase to reporting of data
  • Hands on experience in running GC-MS and GC-FID systems
  • Experience in using Olfactory GC-MS will be considered an advantage
  • Experience in flavor profile analysis will be considered an advantage
  • Hands on experience in setting up and performing sample preparation of biological samples for GC-MS and GC-FID analyses
  • Proven experience in GC-MS and GC-FID method development and validation
  • Strong oral and written skills in English – our communication language is English
  • Flexibility, enthusiasm, responsibility, team spirit and excellent collaboration skills
  • Ability to keep calm in a hectic environment
What we offer in returnWe offer an interesting and challenging job in an international atmosphere with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. We offer a great flexibility in the position. In the area of technical and natural sciences, DTU is one of the leading research and education institutions in Europe.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structuresThe position is a full-time position with a preferred starting date on February 1st, 2027 (or according to mutual agreement).The place of work will The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT), DTU Lyngby Campus.Application and contactPlease submit your online application no later than Monday, 30 November 2026. Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. All applications must be written in English. If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Linda Ahonen, Head of Analytics, linaho@dtu.dk Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.The Novo Nordisk Foundation Biotechnology Research Institute for the Green Transition (BRIGHT) is a major initiative based at DTU that aims to accelerate the development of biosolutions and strengthen the bio-based economy. BRIGHT serves as a hub for academic and industrial partners working together to unlock the potential of bioproduction. BRIGHT focuses on three main areas: Sustainable materials (Developing bio-based alternatives to fossil-derived materials), Microbial foods (Innovating food production through microbial technologies), and Microorganisms for net-zero agriculture (Creating solutions to reduce greenhouse gas emissions in agriculture). The goal is to develop and scale innovative biosolutions within these areas, ultimately creating sustainable and competitive alternatives to fossil-based products and processes that can make significant contributions to reducing global greenhouse gas emissions.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: Financial Controller med erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA
jobs.description: Vi söker en erfaren och analytisk Financial Controller till ett spännande konsultuppdrag i en verksamhet som befinner sig i en större systemförändring. Här får du en central roll i gränslandet mellan Finance/Controlling, verksamheten och ett pågående SAP S/4HANA-projekt. Uppdraget passar dig som trivs nära verksamheten, gillar att kombinera löpande finansiell uppföljning med analys och samtidigt har förståelse för hur ekonomiska strukturer och data behöver fungera i ett nytt system.Till detta uppdrag söker vi efter dig som vill arbeta som konsult via SJR med månadslön samt tjänstepension och övriga villkor enligt kollektivavtal.Om tjänstenI rollen stöttar du verksamheten ur ett finansiellt perspektiv med ansvar för bland annat ekonomisk uppföljning, rapportering, budget och prognos. En viktig del av uppdraget är samtidigt att säkerställa att finansiella strukturer, konton och data förs över och fungerar korrekt i SAP S/4HANA.Du blir en viktig brygga mellan ekonomi, verksamhet och projektorganisationen och bidrar med både din finansiella kompetens och din praktiska erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA Finance. Rollen är operativ och hands-on, samtidigt som den kräver en god analytisk förmåga och förståelse för helheten.AnsvarsområdenI rollen kommer du bland annat att:- Arbeta med finansiell uppföljning, rapportering samt analys av utfall och KPI:er- Ansvara för delar av budget- och prognosarbetet- Arbeta med investeringar, produktkalkyler och business follow-up- Säkerställa att balans- och resultatkonton samt andra finansiella strukturer hanteras korrekt i det nya systemet- Arbeta med Chart of Accounts, G/L account mapping samt finansiell masterdata- Genomföra avstämningar och kvalitetssäkring av migrerad finansiell data- Stötta verksamheten i frågor kopplade till kostnadsställen, profit centers och ekonomiska strukturer- Bidra i UAT, cutover och vid behov hypercare i samband med implementationen- Samarbeta nära Finance/Controlling, verksamheten samt SAP- och IT-specialisterLämplig bakgrundVi söker dig som har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning eller finans och flera års erfarenhet inom exempelvis redovisning, controlling eller business control. Du har en stabil förståelse för både balans- och resultaträkning och är van vid att arbeta med finansiell analys och uppföljning.För rollen behöver du ha praktisk erfarenhet av SAP S/4HANA Finance, framför allt FI/CO, samt god förståelse för Chart of Accounts, G/L accounts, kostnadsställen, profit centers och finansiell masterdata. Har du tidigare arbetat i en S/4HANA-implementation, ERP-migrering eller annan större systemförändring är det mycket meriterande. Erfarenhet av UAT, cutover och hypercare är också en fördel.Du har mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och är van vid att analysera, stämma av och kvalitetssäkra större datamängder. Rollen kräver även att du kan kommunicera obehindrat på engelska i både tal och skrift.Personliga egenskaperSom person är du analytisk, strukturerad och noggrann, samtidigt som du har ett pragmatiskt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt. Du tycker om att sätta dig in i detaljer och identifiera avvikelser, men har också förmågan att förstå hur ekonomi, system och verksamhet hänger ihop.Du är kommunikativ och trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor där du behöver kunna översätta ekonomiska behov och frågeställningar mellan Finance, verksamhet och tekniska SAP-specialister. Du är prestigelös, självgående och bekväm med att arbeta hands-on i en miljö där både processer och system är under förändring.AnsökanFör mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Malin Lindqvist. Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-12-15. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!Konsult hos SJRAtt arbeta som konsult hos SJR innebär att du blir en del av en dedikerad organisation med kompetens att ge dig perfekta förutsättningar att utvecklas både inom din yrkesroll och på ett personligt plan. Du får tillgång till vårt stora nätverk av intressanta företag och uppdragsgivare och därmed en unik möjlighet att ta din karriär till nästa steg.Vi på SJR bryr oss om vår personal och tillsammans med oss får du en långsiktig partner som ger dig trygghet och stöd. Vi är lyhörda för dina behov och du kommer att ha en nära relation med din konsultchef som stöttar dig i din utveckling. #Bildlänkhttps://media.sjr.se/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/konsult_shutterstock_525140848-scaled.jpg

jobs.title: Vil du bli en viktig del av hverdagen min? BPA-assistent søkes!
jobs.description:
Vil du bli en viktig del av hverdagen min? Jeg er en mann først i 30 årene med en lidenskap for fotball, bueskyting, og mange forskjellige spill, som Pokémon Go og TV-spill. Jeg har også en katt som betyr mye for meg, så det er viktig at du ikke er allergisk mot katter.

Min hverdag kan være både rolig og utfordrende, og jeg trenger en assistent som kan håndtere dette. Jeg søker en voksen, selvstendig person som kan hjelpe meg i hverdagen, både hjemme og på aktiviteter. Stillingen er en deltidsjobb med 12 timers vakter, og det finnes muligheter for fast stilling.

Hva går jobben ut på?

Som min assistent trenger jeg blant annet bistand til:

  • Husarbeid, som å vaske klær og lage mat
  • Håndtering av epilepsianfall
  • Medisinhåndtering
  • Bistand til personlig stell
  • Å være med meg på avtaler og utflukter

Jeg håper du er en person som trives med å være utadvendt og initiativrik. Det er viktig å ha førerkort og gode norskkunnskaper, spesielt muntlig. Jeg ser etter noen som er villig til å ta kurs innen medisinhåndtering og epilepsi.

Vi tilbyr
  • En meningsfylt jobb hvor du virkelig kan gjøre en forskjell
  • God opplæring og relevante kurs
  • Tett oppfølging fra en lokal BPA-koordinator

Jeg vil gjerne høre fra deg. Send meg en kort søknad hvor du forteller litt om hvem du er, hvorfor du ønsker jobben, og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Secondary Engineer – Control and Protection, 12-month renewable contract
jobs.description:
Secondary Engineer -- Control and Protection

Oslo, Norway

12-month renewable contract

Grid Protection Client

About the company

Applica are partnering with a leading international provider of technology and engineering solutions for the energy and power sectors, specialising in high-voltage substations, power systems and transmission infrastructure. With an established international engineering network, they deliver projects supporting the development and reliability of energy infrastructure.

About the role

You will be an experienced Secondary Engineer specialising in Control & Protection to support the delivery of high-voltage substation projects across Norway.

You will take responsibility for the engineering and coordination of Control & Protection packages, ensuring designs are technically compliant, complete and delivered to the required standards.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading and coordinating Control & Protection engineering activities, including sub-suppliers.

  • Delivering technical designs, calculations and documentation from base design through to detailed design and as-built documentation.

  • Producing technical drawings, specifications and project procedures.

  • Providing technical recommendations and resolving engineering queries throughout project delivery.

  • Supporting project planning, resource estimates, risk assessments and technical proposals.

  • Working closely with project teams, factories and suppliers across Europe.

  • Providing technical support during installation, testing and commissioning activities.

  • Ensuring compliance with customer requirements, relevant standards and safety regulations.

About you

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering or a similar discipline.

  • A minimum of 5 years' experience within an engineering department or on-site engineering environment.

jobs.title: Kunnossapitäjä, Katsa Oy
jobs.description: **Haemme Katsa Oy:lle Tampereen yksikköön kunnossapitäjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen****Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?** Kunnossapitäjänä huolehdit Katsan toimitilojen ja taloteknisten järjestelmien toimintavarmuudesta sekä tuet tuotannon kunnossapitoa. Työstäsi noin 70 % painottuu kiinteistöjen ja talotekniikan ylläpitoon ja noin 30 % tuotannon kunnossapitoon.Arjessasi huolehdit kiinteistöjen teknisten järjestelmien toiminnasta, huolloista ja tarkastuksista sekä reagoit vikoihin ja poikkeamiin. Työskentelet monipuolisesti mm. LVI-järjestelmien, paineilman ja rakennusautomaation parissa sekä teet yhteistyötä ulkopuolisten huoltoyritysten kanssa. Tuotannon puolella osallistut koneiden ja laitteiden ennakkohuoltoihin, korjaustöihin ja käyttövarmuuden kehittämiseen.Pääasiallinen työpaikkasi sijaitsee Ilmailunkadulla Tampereella, mutta työskentelet tarpeen mukaan myös Katsan muissa toimipisteissä Lakalaivassa, Sääksjärvellä ja Ikaalisissa sekä ensi keväänä valmistuvassa Pirkkalan toimipisteessä.Tällä hetkellä työ on päivätyötä klo 7–15, mutta lähitulevaisuudessa siirrymme kaksivuorotyöhön. Tällöin työskentelet pääosin päivävuorossa ja joka kolmas tai neljäs viikko iltavuorossa klo 14–22.**Mitä me odotamme?** Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää soveltuvaa teknistä ammatillista koulutusta esimerkiksi sähkö-, automaatio-, LVI- tai kunnossapitoalalta sekä aiempaa kokemusta kiinteistötekniikasta tai kunnossapidosta. Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen rakennusautomaatiosta, teollisuuden kunnossapidosta sekä paineilma- ja LVI-järjestelmistä. Myös voimassa oleva SFS 6002 -sähkötyöturvallisuuskoulutus, työturvallisuuskortti ja tulityökortti ovat plussaa.Etsimme ennen kaikkea käytännönläheistä ja oma-aloitteista kunnossapidon osaajaa, joka tarttuu teknisiin haasteisiin rohkeasti ja on motivoitunut kehittämään osaamistaan. Tehtävässä tarvitset suomen kielen taitoa turvalliseen työskentelyyn sekä valmiutta kaksivuorotyöhön. Lisäksi sinulla tulee olla B-ajokortti, sillä työ voi sisältää käyntejä myös Katsan muissa toimipisteissä. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi.**Mitä me tarjoamme?** Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen, monipuolisen ja vastuullisen kunnossapidon tehtävän, jossa pääset työskentelemään sekä kiinteistötekniikan että tuotantoympäristön parissa. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen ja tueksesi kokeneet kollegat, joiden kanssa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi pitkäjänteisesti.Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja alkaa vuokratyösuhteena Biisonin kautta. Kuuden kuukauden jälkeen tehtävässä on mahdollisuus siirtyä Katsan omille kirjoille. Palkka määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.Katsa tarjoaa vakaan työympäristön ja mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäjänteistä uraa teknisessä kunnossapidossa. Tässä tehtävässä pääset ottamaan vastuuta toimitilojen ja tuotannon toimintavarmuudesta sekä tekemään työtä, jonka vaikutus näkyy konkreettisesti arjen sujuvuudessa.

jobs.title: PhD position in biology, specialisation in aquatic ecology
jobs.description: Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua)Third-cycle subject areaBiologyDescription of the doctoral projectA PhD position in biology with specialisation in aquatic ecology is available at the Department of Aquatic Resources at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU Aqua). The theme of the PhD project is on management and conservation methods of critically endangered fishes, focusing on Anguillid eels. Trap and Transport (T&T) is a management method used to enable fish to continue their migration in fragmented riverine systems, and to reduce hydropower turbine mortality for downstream migrating fish. Today, we lack knowledge regarding how T&T should be conducted to optimize the method from an eel’s perspective. The aim of this project is to answer some of these knowledge gaps through field studies, experiments, analysis of existing data, modelling, and via international expert knowledge exchange. The main questions that will be addressed are:     How can the core aspects of the T&T process be optimized from an eel’s perspective?    How is T&T currently conducted in different countries and what can we learn from each other?    In which Swedish watersheds should T&T be prioritized today and in the future?    In addition, the project aims to develop best practice guidelines for T&T to be used at a national and international scale. About the positionThe main task is to conduct the PhD thesis work under supervision, including development of the PhD student's methodological, theoretical, analytical, writing, and presentation skills. The PhD student will conduct experiments in the field, including handling of eels, tagging and more. The work will be done at SLU Aqua in Drottningholm (Stockholm), and at various field sites. The position includes collaboration with international researchers, and one of the co-supervisors is Dr. Derek Evans at the Agri-Food and Bioscience Institute (AFBI), Northern Ireland. The student will also collaborate closely with Dr. Jani Helminen, Natural Resources Institute (LUKE) Finland. RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39). Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in biology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have at least 90 HEC in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 HEC must be at second-cycle level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6. Desirable experience    Experience with animal experiments and/or fieldwork.    Experience working with fish.    Experience with relevant practical and statistical methods.    Experience with independent writing.    Experience with organising workshops or large meetings.    Experience with analysis of large datasets.    Experience in collaboration with commercial fishers, industries and management agencies.    Will contribute to a good working climate.    Good communication skills in English, written and spoken.    Driver’s licence.    Great emphasis on personal qualities, collaboration skills, analytical and problem-solving abilities, and capacity for independent work. About usAt the Department of Aquatic Resources (SLU Aqua) we are passionate about conservation and sustainable management of aquatic animals, including fish. We are geographically distributed across Sweden, and this PhD position will be based in Stockholm at the Institute of Freshwater Research, beautifully situated on the countryside on the island of Lovön right by lake Mälaren. We offer:     An excellent and professionally stimulating working environment with dedicated colleagues    Access to a broad international network of scientists    Salary as PhD research fellow in the state salary scale    Good welfare benefits Read more about SLU Aqua: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/aquatic-resources/ Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/ Read more about PhD courses and PhD study programmes: https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/ Form of employment and salary Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed. Scope100% LocationDrottningholm, Stockholm Start date2027-04-01, or upon agreement. Application and selection Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is 30 November 2027. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update. Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/ Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time. Academic union representativeshttps://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ Note: This is a shortened version of the advertisement adapted to the Swedish Public Employment Service’s (Platsbanken) system. Please see the full advertisement on SLU’s website: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses.

jobs.title: Kok med smag for mere fritid?
jobs.description:
Café OVER-TID i Juelsminde søger endnu en kok, ernæringsassistent eller erfaren køkkenfaglig kollega.

Du holder af at lave ordentlig mad. Af at smage til, bage fra bunden og sende et måltid afsted, du er stolt af. Og du vil gerne have tid til livet uden for køkkenet.

Hos Café OVER-TID får du begge dele: et køkken med forskellige opgaver og plads til dine idéer – og en arbejdsrytme med weekendvagt hver femte weekend, kun én aftenvagt om ugen i vinterhalvåret og mindre arbejde fra påske til september.

Fra surdej til selskaber

Du finder os i Juelsminde Hallerne, hvor Café OVER-TID samler mennesker om mad og fællesskab. Køkkenet laver både mad til caféens gæster, Take Away, mad ud af huset, selskaber, møder og events. Vi står også for frokostordninger til virksomheder, blandt andre JUAL.

Vi laver mad fra bunden og bager selv vores brød – gerne med surdej. Her får du brugt dit håndværk på tværs af hverdagsmad, caféretter og selskabsmenuer. Og du får mulighed for at præge menuerne, ugens retter og måden, vi arbejder på.

God mad. Og tid til andet.

Arbejdet følger husets sæson. Vi arbejder mere om vinteren og har nedsat arbejdstid fra påske til september, så der er ekstra tid til at nyde de varme dage.

●     Weekendvagt hver femte weekend.

●     Kun én aftenvagt om ugen i vinterhalvåret.

●     Færre arbejdstimer fra påske til september.

●     Et lille team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og giver plads til faglige input.

●     Indflydelse på maden og arbejdsgangene i køkkenet.

Der er også travle dage og arrangementer, der kræver, at vi løfter sammen. Du får en hverdag med både planlagt produktion og gæster i huset.

Du kan dit håndværk – og tager ansvar

Du er kok, ernæringsassistent, cater eller har solid erfaring fra et professionelt køkken. Det afgørende er, at du kan lave velsmagende mad fra bunden og arbejde selvstændigt med kvalitet og overblik.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

●     Kan planlægge og tilberede mad til både daglig drift og arrangementer.

●     Har styr på hygiejne, egenkontrol og orden i køkkenet.

●     Tager initiativ og har lyst til at bidrage med idéer.

●     Hjælper kollegerne og bevarer overblikket, når der er flere ting i gang.

●     Trives med gæstekontakt og livet i et hus med børn, unge og voksne.

Du bliver en del af hverdagen i både køkkenet og caféen. Vi deles om opgaverne, så både maden, servicen og samarbejdet fungerer.

Lad os tage en snak

Har du lyst til at se køkkenet og høre mere om jobbet? Ring til centerchef Britta Roslyng på 44 14 36 10. Vi tager gerne en uformel snak over en kop kaffe.

Du kan også sende dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv og din køkkenerfaring til brg@jhacenter.dk.

Tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

Arbejdssted: Café OVER-TID, Juelsminde Hallerne, Tofteskovvej 12, 7130 Juelsminde.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Financial Controlling / Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description: Job DescriptionJoin H&M Tech and shape the digital backbone of Finance. The role sits within the Finance Area in the Corporate domain, where we combine business expertise and modern technology to build scalable, compliant and efficient solutions for core finance processes. The role is dedicated to one product: Financial Controlling/Financial Planning & Analysis, which enables fast, reliable and transparent financial steering for Controlling, the CFO and CIO Offices, Accounting and Store Management. It covers financial reporting and analytics, daily turnover follow-up, planning and forecasting, and tech finance data, cost transparency and allocation. As Engineering Manager, you will lead the product’s technical delivery and operations. You will partner with the Product Manager, who owns the roadmap, and work closely with Controlling, architecture and engineering teams to turn complex needs into reliable digital solutions. You’ll lead through technology, direction and collaboration, not through direct staff responsibility.  WHAT YOU'LL DO You will lead the product across three delivery teams of H&M engineers, consultants and business experts:     Supporting financial reporting, analytics and daily turnover     Supporting planning, forecasting and investment planning      Supporting Tech Financial – tech finance data, cost transparency and allocation Delivery and roadmap     Lead end-to-end technical delivery, from financial data and reporting to planning and tech cost transparency.     Partner with the Product Manager and Finance stakeholders on roadmap, priorities and releases, bringing technical feasibility and trade-off insights.     Ensure the teams have the right skills, capacity and partners to deliver on agreed priorities.     Own delivery quality across initiatives, continuous improvement (CI) and run, including timely execution of prioritized features and epics.     Ensure solutions are well documented, with AI readability and automation in mind. Operational excellence     Be accountable for the product’s health, monitoring, stability, security and scalability, including incident handling in key periods such as budget and forecast cycles.     Champion data quality and trusted, consistent financial data.     Drive simplification, automation and continuous improvement in line with tech strategy, architecture standards and engineering guardrails.     Follow up delivery and performance KPIs, and proactively manage risks, dependencies and technical debt. Technical leadership     Set technical direction for a landscape that currently combines cloud-native solutions in Microsoft Azure with SaaS platforms such as Anaplan and Apptio.     Uphold engineering standards across architecture, DevOps, CI/CD, security and compliance, balancing delivery speed with technical health and long-term scalability.     Work with solution and enterprise solution architects and lead engineers on solution design, ensuring coherence with adjacent products and the long-term target state. Collaboration, partners and financial accountability     Act as the main tech contact for the product, working closely with the Product Manager, Controlling and other Finance stakeholders.     Collaborate with other tech functions, such as platform, data and AI teams, to solve cross-domain challenges.     Own collaboration with vendors and service providers, including SaaS and managed service contracts, to ensure short- and long-term stability.     Be accountable for the product’s tech costs (budget, actuals and forecast), with a focus on cost efficiency and total cost of ownership.     Share clear updates on status, progress, risks and dependencies. Team and culture     Build a high-performing, inclusive and psychologically safe culture across the teams.     Coach engineers and partners to grow and perform and drive continuous improvement in ways of working and engineering practices.     Plan and contribute to team development together with other Engineering Managers and Competence Managers.  WHO YOU ARE You are an engineering leader who combines technical depth, delivery focus and collaboration. You enjoy working close to the business and know that trusted data and stable solutions come from engineering discipline, learning and simplification.     Experience as a senior software engineer and/or in technical solution leadership, with several years in senior or lead roles leading teams through major deliveries.     Experience leading technical delivery in a product-oriented environment, in close partnership with product and business.     Solid understanding of architecture, scalable design, cloud fundamentals and modern engineering practices such as agile, DevOps and CI/CD.     A DevOps mindset and a track record of building and running stable products, including RUN, delivery, security, monitoring and incident management.     Comfortable with complex business processes, ideally within finance, controlling, planning, reporting, analytics or regulated environments. Experience with data warehousing, BI or planning platforms such as Anaplan is a plus.     Financial acumen and experience managing tech budgets and forecasts, as well as vendors, consultants and SaaS partners.     Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence without formal people management responsibility.     Clear, collaborative and pragmatic — you balance speed, quality, risk and long-term value, and turn complexity into action.     A genuine drive to lead, develop and build strong teams and culture.     Curious about how technology, automation, data and AI can create better experiences and decisions. At H&M Tech, you’ll help build the finance capabilities that keep the business moving, creating solutions that are simple, scalable and ready for what’s next.  WHO WE ARE H&M Group is a global company with strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values.

jobs.title: Senior Partnership & Business Development
jobs.description:
Senior Partnership & Business Development

Vil du med på en vækstrejse i en digital startup, hvor dine idéer og resultater i høj grad er med til at definere vejen? Vi søger en struktureret, analytisk og kommercielt tænkende profil, der kan udvikle vores samarbejdspartnere og skabe stærke resultater gennem strategiske partnerskaber.

Studiz er bl.a. landets største platform for studierabat til verificerede studerende med mere end 400.000 medlemmer. Vores platform giver virksomheder mulighed for at opbygge en tidlig relation til fremtidens mest købestærke kundesegment. Se mere på www.studiz.dk.

Vi arbejder med samspillet mellem brands og studerende, og det er i dette krydsfelt, at din rolle skal udfolde sig i tæt samarbejde med vores CMO.

Du får budgetansvar for din egen portefølje og vil samtidig være den drivende kraft i flere interne projekter, hvor du skal hjælpe og vejlede vores praktikanter og studentermedhjælpere.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Strategisk rådgivning: Være en aktiv sparringspartner, der kan udfordre eksisterende tilgange og rådgive om, hvordan samarbejdet kan skabe størst mulig værdi for partnerens forretning.

  • Planlægning og eksekvering: Udarbejde aktivitetsplaner og omsætte strategiske mål til konkrete marketingaktiviteter og kommercielle initiativer.

  • Data og performance: Analysere resultater på tværs af vores partnere, egne aktiviteter og brugernes adfærd. Forstå, hvad tallene fortæller, identificere mønstre og undersøge, hvad der driver resultaterne.

  • Brugerindsigt og adfærd: Forstå, hvad der motiverer vores brugere, og hvordan de reagerer på forskellige indsatser. Hvilken betydning har eksempelvis billeder, budskaber, formater og sendetidspunkter for engagement og handling?

  • Test og optimering: Opstille hypoteser, teste nye initiativer og evaluere effekten. Bruge resultaterne til løbende at forbedre vores aktiviteter og skabe bedre resultater for både partnere og brugere.

En central del af stillingen er at forstå og udvikle samspillet mellem tre områder: vores partnere, vores egen forretning og vores brugere.

Det handler om at kunne se sammenhængene og bruge dem aktivt. Vi skal med andre ord ikke blot kunne aflæse vores data, men også forstå, hvad der ligger bag tallene, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og omsætte indsigterne til handling. Det kræver en person, der kombinerer analytisk nysgerrighed med kommerciel forståelse og evnen til at se det større perspektiv.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling inden for marketing og dermed både kommerciel og strategisk forståelse samt dokumenterede resultater.

  • Er analytisk og motiveres af at arbejde med data, indsigter og performance.

  • Er nysgerrig på brugeradfærd og interesseret i at forstå, hvad der driver engagement og handling.

  • Kan se sammenhængen mellem marketing, brugeradfærd og salg.

  • Har forståelse for at arbejde med hypoteser, tests og løbende optimering.

  • Tør udfordre eksisterende løsninger og komme med nye idéer.

  • Er struktureret og god til at omsætte strategier til konkrete handlinger.

Herudover vil det være en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til både affiliate- og bureauverdenen.

Men vigtigst af alt er det, at du er nysgerrig på forretningen, menneskene og dataene bag resultaterne. Du skal have lyst til at forstå, hvorfor noget virker, hvordan vi kan gøre det endnu bedre, og hvordan vi skaber værdi for både vores samarbejdspartnere, brugere og virksomheden.

Derudover får du:

  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

  • Stor arbejdsfrihed.

  • Sociale arrangementer.

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes til job@studiz.dk

Ansøgninger modtages løbende, og vi indkalder til samtaler, indtil den rette kandidat er fundet. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Sille Kaalund på tel. 50 40 62 80.

Når du sender din ansøgning og dit CV, accepterer du, at vi opbevarer dine personlige oplysninger, så længe rekrutteringsprocessen varer.

Studiz er en dansk virksomhed, skabt og drevet af studerende, med det formål at gøre hverdagen sjovere, billigere og enklere for verificerede studerende. Siden 2013 har Studiz hjulpet virksomheder med at opbygge loyalitet og gjort det nemmere for studerende at få adgang til studierabatter, bl.a. via det personlige digitale studiekort i Studiz-app'en.

jobs.title: Orthoptiste en cabinet d'Ophtalmologie (H/F)
jobs.description: Cabinet d'Ophtalmologie à Neufchâtel en Bray (Seine-Maritime - 76) recherche un(e) Orthoptiste pour CDD de 3 mois à temps partiel 27 heures par semaine pour activité salariée de préconsultation ophtalmologique au sein d'un cabinet de 4 Ophtalmologistes. Vos missions : L'orthoptiste est un professionnel de santé spécialisé dans la rééducation et le dépistage des troubles visuels. Ses missions s'articulent principalement autour de deux axes : le bilan et la rééducation.Missions de l'orthoptiste- Le bilan orthoptique : Il réalise des examens pour dépister les troubles de la vision, tels que le strabisme (déviation des yeux), l'amblyopie (diminution de l'acuité visuelle), ou encore les troubles de la convergence et de l'accommodation.- La rééducation visuelle : À partir des résultats du bilan, il met en place des séances de rééducation pour améliorer la coordination des yeux, la vision binoculaire (utilisation des deux yeux ensemble) et la motricité oculaire.- Le suivi thérapeutique : Il assure le suivi des patients (enfants ou adultes) présentant des troubles visuels spécifiques ou des pathologies nécessitant une prise en charge complémentaire à celle de l'ophtalmologiste.Poste à pourvoir dès que possible.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Plant Stress and Nitrogen Metabolism
jobs.description: Department of Forest Ecology and Management Scientific backgroundPlants do more with organic nitrogen than use it for growth. Amino acids and their derivatives can also be diverted into signalling pathways that shape development and help plants respond to environmental stress. We are seeking a motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to investigate how this redirection of organic nitrogen metabolism is regulated and what it means for plant stress tolerance.About the position  The project explores the links between organic nitrogen metabolism, metabolic regulation and downstream signalling cascades, and their roles in plant responses to abiotic and biotic challenges, including pathogen attack. The work will combine physiological, biochemical, molecular and advanced imaging approaches, using Arabidopsis thaliana alongside crop species in sterile, hydroponic and soil-based systems. The position is particularly suitable for a candidate who wishes to build an independent research profile at the interface of plant nutrition, metabolic signalling and stress biologyKey responsibilitiesThe successful candidate will:    Plan and carry out experiments on plant growth, development and stress responses under controlled conditions    Use chemical and genetic approaches to manipulate organic nitrogen metabolism and signalling    Perform gene expression, metabolite and biochemical analyses    Carry out microscopy-based analyses, including confocal and two-photon imaging    Develop and run stress and infection mimicking bioassays as well as nematode assays    Analyse and interpret data, and publish results in international scientific journals    Contribute to experimental planning and take an active part in the group’s national and international collaborations, and in the supervision of studentsYour profileRequired qualifications    PhD in plant biology, plant physiology, molecular biology, biochemistry or a closely related discipline.     Documented experience with experimental plant research, experimental design and data analysis    Documented scientific publishing in international peer-reviewed journals    Ability to plan, execute and document experiments independently    Very good written and spoken EnglishMeritorious qualifications Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered a strong advantage:    Gene expression analysis, particularly qRT-PCR    In vitro sterile culture techniques    Work with Arabidopsis thaliana and crop species    Two-photon microscopy and advanced confocal microscopy    Hydroponic cultivation and soil-based treatments    Mass spectrometry (MS) and metabolite analysis    Phytopathology and plant–pathogen interactions    Bioassay development and implementation, particularly nematode culture and infection assaysGreat importance will be placed on personal qualities such as curiosity, independence, problem-solving ability and the ability to work well with others.As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most. If there are special circumstances, such a degree may have been awarded earlier. Special circumstances include leave due to illness, parental leave, positions of trust within trade union organizations, service within the total defence system, or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or other employment/assignments relevant to the subject area. About us  The position is based at the Department of Forest Ecology and Management at SLU in Umeå, within the research group led by Professor Torgny Näsholm. The group investigates plant nitrogen nutrition, with a particular focus on the acquisition and utilization of organic nitrogen and their roles in plant physiology and growth. The project will be supervised day to day by Dr Ioanna Antoniadi-Nilsson.The Postdoc. will be employed at The Department of Forest Ecology and Management. The department includes about 120 people of which 9 are professors. jobs.title: Teamspective: Account Executive (Denmark or Sweden)
jobs.description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki, Copenhagen, Stockholm**Application deadline:** Tue 1.12.2026Join Teamspective, a fast-growing Finnish AI-native SaaS company transforming how organizations lead their people. We're hiring two Account Executives to drive our expansion into Denmark and Sweden!**Your role with us**Teamspective is on a mission to make great leadership a competitive advantage. Our AI-native platform turns employee insights into practical guidance for leaders routines, helping managers lead better every day. With strong growth, proven customer success across the Nordics, and ambitious international plans, we're now ready to accelerate our expansion into Denmark and Sweden.As our **Account Executive for Denmark**, you'll build on our existing customer relationships and strong references, including **Danfoss**, to expand Teamspective's presence in the Danish market. As our **Account Executive for Sweden**, youll focus on opening new opportunities and growing our customer base in a market where were already working with companies like **Hitta.se**. In either role, you'll take ownership of your market and help shape how Teamspective grows internationally.**Your key responsibilities will include:**- Owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline building to closing deals, with a focus on mid-sized and large organizations. - Leading discovery meetings and product demos to uncover customer needs and demonstrate Teamspective's value. - Driving B2B sales processes from initial contact to negotiations, procurement, and closing. - Building trusted relationships with HR leaders and other decision-makers through consultative selling. - Developing your market approach and identifying opportunities to scale Teamspective's presence in your country. You'll work closely with our CRO and CEO, existing sales team, and colleagues in customer success and product development, giving you direct access to commercial leadership and the expertise behind our product.Looking further ahead, as Teamspective's presence in your market grows, you could have the opportunity to step into a Country Manager role and build and lead your own local sales team.**Who we're looking for**You're a commercially driven, hands-on sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships, and turning opportunities into results. You know how to engage HR decision-makers and understand what drives their business. You bring strong Danish or Swedish language skills and an understanding of your respective market. Above all, you thrive on taking ownership and are excited to build and grow a market over the long term.**What we expect from you:**- At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably SaaS, technology, or HR-related - Experience in solution sales to a clearly defined B2B customer segment, with the ability to understand customer challenges and demonstrate business value - A proven track record in new business acquisition and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals - A proactive, independent approach to sales and the drive to build your own pipeline and develop a market - Excellent Danish skills for the Denmark position, or excellent Swedish skills for the Sweden position, alongside good English skills **What we consider a plus:**- Experience selling HR technology solutions or other B2B solutions to HR decision-makers, with an understanding of their business challenges - An established network of HR leaders and decision-makers in Denmark or Sweden - Previous experience opening new markets or developing sales operations in an international growth company **What we offer you:**- Build your market and shape the go-to-market strategy with real ownership. - Sell an AI-native solution that helps organizations turn better leadership into a competitive advantage. - Work alongside experienced leaders and a tight-knit team that moves fast and has your back. - Drive international growth with a proven product, strong customer references, and room to make your mark. - Grow toward a potential Country Manager role and eventually build and lead your own local team. **Practicalities:**These are full-time, permanent positions in which you will be employed directly by Teamspective. You can be based in Helsinki or your respective target market, Copenhagen or Stockholm, after the initial onboarding period. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible in early 2027.**Onboarding:**The role requires you to spend your first 3–6 months working in Helsinki. During this period, you will work closely with Teamspective's commercial, customer success, and product teams, build a deep understanding of the product, and start developing your market from day one. Teamspective will cover accommodation in Helsinki for candidates relocating temporarily. After onboarding, you can work from Helsinki or your respective target country, with regular visits to Helsinki.**Compensation:**The base salary in this position starts from 4000 €/month, complemented by an uncapped commission. As an indicative estimate, on-target earnings (OTE) could range from 90-110 000 euros annually, depending on sales performance. The commission model also includes incentives for qualified meetings during the probationary period. You'll also join Teamspective's employee stock option program after your probationary period. As you grow into a Sales Manager or Country Manager role, there may be opportunities to negotiate a larger equity stake.**Ready to build success in a new market?**Please submit your CV and brief motivation statement by the latest Tue 1st of December 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/396854/create/.Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

jobs.title: Researcher
jobs.description:
About the position

A full-time researcher position (SKO 1109) is available at the Center for Lifespan Changes in Brain and Cognition (LCBC), Department of Psychology (PSI), Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Oslo. The researcher will work full time on the Horizon Europe project SHIELD - Sources of Health Inequalities from Environmental Pollution in Lifespan Brain Development, funded by the Horizon Europe programme. SHIELD investigates how environmental exposures affect brain health and brain diseases across the entire lifespan, from conception to old age. 

The position will focus on environmental exposure modelling and the generation of environmental exposure maps for the SHIELD cohorts, as well as MRI data analysis. We are particularly looking for a candidate who can work at the interface of brain imaging and environmental exposure data, with a strong research background in MRI data analysis and experience with using environmental and geographic databases. Transdisciplinary experience and interest will be an advantage, as the consortium involves partners from multiple fields, including (but not limited to) psychology, medicine, physics, environmental epidemiology and statistical modelling. 

As SHIELD is expected to generate significant impacts, the researcher will be expected also to contribute to stakeholder engagement and science communication activities, for example by participating in stakeholder workshops and contributing to policy briefs, newsletters, and social media posts. 

The research position is funded until the end of the project, 31 December 2031. LCBC is the coordinator of the SHIELD consortium, which includes 13 partners, and this position will be one of the key roles in the entire consortium. The position and its associated tasks are funded only for the stated period and will end when the funding period expires.

More about the position and the research center

The goal of LCBC is to understand differences and changes in brain and cognition across the entire lifespan, and to identify how brain function and cognition can be optimized. LCBC is an active, multidisciplinary research center with around 25 full-time staff members, including four professors, two researchers, several postdoctoral fellows and PhD candidates, chief and senior data engineers, full- and part-time research assistants, administrative support, and several affiliated international researchers. 

LCBC has excellent research infrastructure, including access to a 3T Siemens Prisma MRI scanner, PET and EEG facilities, and comprehensive neuropsychological and somatic testing facilities. English is the main working language at the center.

LCBC has secured several large grants, including four European Research Council (ERC) grants, a Horizon 2020 grant, and several grants from the Research Council of Norway, the National Health Association of Norway, and the University of Oslo. In 2015, the group was designated “world-leading” and is one of only five such groups at the University of Oslo. More information is available on the LCBC website: https://www.lcbc.uio.no. 

Your main tasks will be
  • Processing and analyzing multimodal brain MRI (structural, diffusion, and quantitative imaging) and cognitive trajectory and modeling these in relation to exposures. 
  • Processing and analyzing behavioral and health data and modeling these in relation to brain and exposure data. 
  • Characterizing and modelling historical air pollution concentrations (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, etc.) for the SHIELD cohorts by integrating Chemical Transport Model (CTM) simulation outputs with emission inventories and observational datasets. 
  • Generating environmental exposure maps extending back to 1920 by combining diverse open-source datasets (meteorological, emissions, and land-use data) for SHIELD's Age-Period-Cohort (APC)-corrected analyses.
  • Contribute to harmonization, expansion and application of EXPANSE maps. 
  • Collaborate with other SHIELD researchers and participate in the SHIELD consortium meetings. 
  • Write and publish scientific articles. 
  • Contribute to stakeholder engagement and science communication activities of SHIELD: participating at workshops, writing policy-briefs, newsletters, social media posts etc.
Qualifications

In this role you must have 

  • PhD in a relevant field such as Neuroscience, Meteorology, Physics, Biophysics, Complex systems, Data Modelling, or a highly related, quantitative natural science/interdisciplinary field. 
  • Research experience in Computational Neuroimaging analysis (structural, functional, diffusion, or quantitative MRI). 
  • Experience with the use of meteorological/climate, spatial, or similar multidimensional databases. 
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R. 
  • Very good proficiency in written and spoken English is a prerequisite.

It is an advantage if you have

  • Experience with secure computing and data-handling environments suitable for sensitive human cohort data. 
  • Experience with research in interdisciplinary/transdisciplinary research environments. 
  • Experience in science communication and outreach activities.
Personal qualities

In the evaluation of applicants, emphasis will be placed on the following personal skills: 

  • Cooperation skills, and the ability to successfully join an international academic collaboration. 
  • Professional and personal ability to work independently.   

In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed upon the quality of the candidate's academic qualifications. Interviews with selected candidates will be arranged where the applicant's prerequisites, interest in and motivation for the field of research, and cooperative skills will be assessed. 

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 

We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed, highly competent colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK 720 000 - 820 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Planned start date: 1st April 2027.

Application

Your application should include:

  • Letter of application, 1-2 pages, explaining the motivation for applying.
  • Curriculum Vitae summarizing education, positions, and academic work.
  • Copies of educational certificates, publications/academic work (if any) that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee.
  • Names and contact details of at least two references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail, and telephone number).
  • International applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their University’s grading system.

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to  Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Psychology is one of seven units of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and has 75 permanent and 70 temporary members of scientific staff. Degrees are offered at bachelor and master level, plus a clinical training programme, and the PhD programme has 140 students.

jobs.title: Nurse or Cardiac Technician with experience analyzing ECG reports
jobs.description:
At Cortrium, we are improving cardiac diagnostics with innovative and user-friendly ECG technology used by healthcare professionals in over 20 countries.

We are looking for a dedicated nurse or Cardiac Technician with experience in ECG analysis and interpretation to strengthen our team and contribute to our continued growth.

About the role

Our ECG analysis department is an international team of 35 dedicated colleagues, including cardiac nurses, cardiac technicians, lab technicians, cardiologists, and general practitioners. We offer regular training sessions to promote learning and professional development.

 Your responsibilities:

  • Quality review of ECG analyses

  • Provide feedback to our R&D team to help further develop our ECG analysis system and ensure optimal results for both healthcare professionals and patients

About you

Your qualifications:

  • Background as a cardiac nurse or ECG/cardiac technician

  • At least two years of experience in cardiology

  • Team player with the drive to make a difference

  • Systematic and detail-oriented

  • Fluent in English, and/or Danish

What we offer

Hours, and work environment: 

  • Part-time or full-time

  • Possibility to work partly from home after onboarding

  • A positive and respectful work environment with a focus on work-life balance

  • Creative office located in Høje Taastrup, just outside Copenhagen, with parking, train access, and startup vibes. Enjoy daily meals, great coffee, and a bright, inspiring workspace

We offer a complete long-term ECG solution and are dedicated to making ECG simple – from recording to analysis. Our cable-free and lightweight C3⁺ Holter monitor ensures high comfort for patients, and we deliver long-term ECG reports verified by cardiology experts. We support healthcare professionals in over 20 countries and have produced more than 500,000 reports.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer Energy Storage
jobs.employer: KONGSBERG DISCOVERY AS AVD BERGEN HEGRENESVEIEN
jobs.description:
There has never been a more exciting time to work with Kongsberg Maritime than right now. With us in Energy Storage System, you will be in the forefront of enabling electrification of the maritime sector. We are a key advisor of Kongsberg Maritime electrical strategy. You will be joining the organization at a time when innovation is key to the success of the company, and we want people to help us shape this journey.

Energy Storage Systems is part of Power Systems Design & Technology. As Lead Engineer – Energy Storage Systems, you will take a leading technical role in the development, integration and lifecycle support of our battery systems. The position requires a strong understanding of battery technology, electrical system design and how energy storage systems interact with the vessel's overall power system.You will work across disciplines and functions, turning requirements into robust technical solutions while supporting projects, product development, sales and aftermarket.

What you will be doing• Lead the technical development and engineering of energy storage systems, with responsibility for overall system design and technical solutions • Define system architecture, requirements and digital solutions for battery modules and systems• Ensure that energy storage solutions comply with applicable regulations, classification requirements and internal technical standards • Plan and coordinate verification and validation activities, including design reviews, testing and technical qualification• Act as a technical authority and advisor within energy storage towards projects, product teams, sales and aftermarket• Provide technical guidance and support to engineers and contribute to developing engineering methods, tools and best practices

We think you should have• BSc or MSc in Power System Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related field.• Relevant experience may compensate for formal education• Experience with electrical power systems, battery systems or energy storage system integration• Knowledge of relevant industry standards, classification society rules and flag-state requirements is an advantage• Experience with verification, testing, troubleshooting or technical qualification is an advantage• Ability to work across disciplines and translate complex technical challenges into practical engineering solutions• Fluent written and oral communication skills in English

This employment may require a pre-employment check procedure in accordance with company security standards, role or site requirements. Please note that this might affect the offer process or employment.

At Kongsberg Maritime, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We encourage you to apply, even if you do not meet every requirement. Your unique perspective is valuable to us. Your skills, attitude and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for!

You are able to• Build strong relationships and collaborate across teams and disciplines• act on own initiative, make things happen and accepts responsibility for the results• adhere to company rules and procedures and execute plans with commitment and determination• use a methodical and systematic approach, plan ahead, define clear priorities and allocates resources effectively• analyse complex issues and problems and come up with rational judgments• demonstrate specialist knowledge and expertise in own area

We are continuously reviewing candidates, apply today!

Why join us• An exciting and important position working for the world-leading supplier of maritime solutions• Engage in complex, high-impact initiatives that push the boundaries of maritime technology.• We offer competitive pay based on objective criteria to ensure fairness and internal equity along with pension contributions, health- and employee insurance.• Take part in the green shift for the ocean space and work with sustainable and exciting solutions for the future.

Where you will be workingBergen, Norway or any other KM Location

Interested in knowing more? ContactDirector, Energy Storage - Anders Helland, +47 958 75 775
