jobs.title: Gårdtrækker, 34 timer / Yard driver, 34 hours per week
jobs.description:
Vi søger lige nu en Gårdtrækker til REMA Distribution A/S på Hjulmagervej 12 i Vejle

Som medarbejder hos REMA Distribution bliver du del af en virksomhed, der vil være bedst til at drive dagligvarebutik i Danmark – med fokus på kvalitet til lave priser. Du får en central rolle i denne proces og bliver en del af vores gårdtrækkerteam fuld af dygtige og kompetente kolleger i Vejle.

Om jobbetMed reference til Driftschefen indgår du i vores team af medarbejdere, som arbejder tæt sammen med vores lager og logistikafdeling.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver:

  • Kørsel med Gårdtrækker på terminalområdet

  • Til- og frakobling af trailere

  • Klargøring til læsning og losning

  • Truckkørsel og intern transport

  • Læsning, losning og håndtering af gods

  • Lager- og terminalopgaver efter behov

  • Rengøring af Terberg.

Vores lager sørger for, at traileren er læsset og klar, inden den skal fjernes. Du får et selvstændigt og udfordrende fuldtidsjob med løn iflg. overenskomst, pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

Du vil skulle arbejde i et 3-ugers rul. Arbejdstiden er om eftermiddagen og skifter i tidsrummet ml. kl. 10.00 og kl. 23.00. Der må påregnes overarbejde i travle perioder.

Dine faglige kvalifikationer

  • Du har kørekort til C/E, chaufføruddannelsesbevis, førerkort og truckcertifikat

  • Du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling

  • Du taler og skriver dansk og/eller engelsk

Dine personlige kvalifikationer

Du er som person selvstændig, serviceminded og sætter en ære i at gøre tingene ordentligt. Som medarbejder og kollega er du fleksibel på arbejdstiden, mødestabil og imødekommende. Du arbejder effektivt uden at miste fokus på sikkerheden, og du har lyst til at give vores kunder en god oplevelse, hvor end du kommer.

Om REMA 1000

I REMA 1000 er vi mere end 17.500 entusiastiske mennesker med ét fælles mål: Vi vil være bedst til at drive dagligvarebutik i Danmark – med fokus på kvalitet til lave priser. Det absolut vigtigste element i den mission er engagerede og virkelystne mennesker, som elsker at gøre en forskel i deres job.

Vi har i dag flere end 440 butikker, og butikkerne er drevet efter en franchisemodel med selvstændige, lokalkendte købmænd i spidsen for den enkelte butik.

I Baglandet hos REMA 1000 / REMA Distribution er vi mere end 1.300 medarbejdere, som skaber konkurrencekraft, servicerer og leverer varer til REMA 1000 butikkerne og andre kæder indenfor dagligvare- og convenience branchen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?Så send os en ansøgning til Drifschef Brian Schmidt på mail: bsc@rema1000.dk .

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig. 

Vi vurderer ansøgningerne løbende, og jobannoncen vil derfor blive fjernet når passende kandidat er fundet.

ENGLISH:

We are currently looking for a Yard Driver to join REMA Distribution A/S, Hjulmagervej 12, Vejle in Denmark.

As an employee at REMA Distribution, you will become part of a company that aims to be the best at operating grocery stores in Denmark, with a focus on providing quality at low prices. You will play an important role in this process and become part of our yard shunter team in Vejle, working alongside skilled and competent colleagues.

About the job

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be part of a team working closely with our warehouse and logistics department.

Responsibilities

·       Your duties will include:

·       Operating a yard driver within the terminal area.

·       Connect and Disconnect trailers.

·       Preparing trailers for loading and unloading.

·       Operating forklifts and carrying out internal transport.

·       Loading, unloading and handling goods.

·       Performing warehouse and terminal duties as required.

·       Cleaning of Terberg.

Our warehouse team ensures that trailers are loaded and ready before they need to be moved.

You will have an independent and challenging full-time position with pay in accordance with the applicable collective agreement, as well as a pension scheme and health insurance.

You will work on a 3-week rotating schedule. Your working hours will vary between 10:00 and 23:00. Overtime should be expected during busy periods.

Your professional qualifications

  • You hold a valid Category C/E driving licence, Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC), driver card and forklift licence

  • You have experience from a similar position

  • You are able to speak and write Danish and/or English

Your personal qualities

You are independent, service-minded and take pride in doing your job properly.

As an employee and colleague, you are flexible regarding working hours, reliable and approachable. You work efficiently without compromising safety, and you are motivated to provide our customers with a positive experience wherever your work takes you.

About REMA 1000

At REMA 1000, we are more than 17,500 enthusiastic employees working towards one common goal: to be the best at operating grocery stores in Denmark, with a focus on providing quality at low prices.

The most important element in achieving this mission is having dedicated and motivated people who are passionate about making a difference in their work.

Today, we have more than 435 stores, operated according to a franchise model, with independent local franchisees responsible for each individual store.

At REMA 1000 / REMA Distribution's support organisation, we have more than 1,300 employees who help strengthen our competitiveness, provide services and deliver goods to REMA 1000 stores and other chains within the grocery and convenience sector.

Does this sound like the job for you?

Please send your application to Operations Manager Brian Schmidt by email at bsc@rema1000.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the job advertisement will therefore be removed once a suitable candidate has been found.

jobs.title: Koulupsykologin virka Perhonjokilaakson alueella
jobs.description: Keski-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueella Soitessa on haettavana KOULUPSYKOLOGIN VIRKA pe 27.11.2026 klo 12.00 mennessäTervetuloa tekemään kanssamme mielenkiintoista ja merkityksellistä psykologin työtä, oppimaan uutta ja kehittymään psykologian alan ammattilaisena!Soiten opiskeluhuollossa työskentelee tällä hetkellä johtavan koulupsykologin ja johtavan koulukuraattorin lisäksi yhdeksän koulupsykologia, 16 koulukuraattoria ja neljä vastaavaa koulukuraattoria. Haemme joukkoomme koulupsykologia Perhonjokilaakson alueelle 1.1.2027 alkaen.Meillä koulupsykologina pääset toteuttamaan monipuolisesti ja luovasti yhteisöllistä ja yksilöllistä opiskeluhuoltoa henkilöstömitoituksen mukaisella oppilasmäärällä (780 oppilasta / koulupsykologi).Tarjoamme sinulle:- työyhteisön ja kokeneiden kollegojen tiiviin tuen- viikoittaiset, saman pöydän ääressä toteutuvat tiimipalaverit- säännöllisen työnohjauksen- tukea kouluttautumiseen- [kilpailukykyisen palkan]- mahdollisuuden tehdä osin etätyötä- mahdollisuuden tehdä osa-aikaista työtä- työn aloitusta tukevan suunnitelmallisen perehdytyksenKoulupsykologin työssä menestymistä edesauttavat hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, kyky itsenäiseen ja tiimityöskentelyyn sekä kehittävä ja vastuullinen työote. Pätevyysvaatimuksena virkaan on laillistetun psykologin kelpoisuus (272/2005). Palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon henkilöstön työ- ja virkaehtosopimuksen (SOTE-sopimus) mukaisesti. Työaika on 37 h 45 min viikossa.Virkaa haetaan täyttämällä sähköinen hakemus osoitteessa www.soite.fi/tyopaikat . Sähköiseen hakemukseen pyydetään liittämään CV. Sähköisessä haussa ei tarvitse toimittaa jäljennöksiä tutkinto- ja työtodistuksista, mutta ne on varauduttava esittämään mahdollisessa haastattelussa.Ennen viran vastaanottamista hakijan tulee esittää hyvinvointialueen henkilökunnan työterveyslääkärin lausunto työkelpoisuudestaan (sis. huumausainetesti). Lisäksi virkaan valitun on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu ote rikosrekisteristä (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002). Virassa noudatetaan 6 kuukauden koeaikaa.Lisätietoa antaa johtava koulupsykologi Johanna Puumala puh. 040 806 5352 ja toimintayksikön vastaava esihenkilö Maarit Biskop puh. 040 806 5151, s-posti: etunimi.sukunimi(at)soite.fi.Kokkola 11.11.2026Mellersta Österbottens Välfärdsområde Soite ledigförklarar att sökas senast fredag 27.11.2026 kl. 12.00 EN TJÄNST SOM SKOLPSYKOLOGVälkommen att utföra intressant och meningsfullt psykologarbete med oss, lära dig nya saker och utvecklas som yrkesperson inom psykologin!Inom Soites elev- och studerandevård arbetar det för närvarande utöver en ledande skolpsykolog och en ledande skolkurator också nio skolpsykologer, 16 skolkuratorer och fyra ansvariga skolkuratorer. Vi söker en skolpsykolog till vårt team i Perho ådals område med start 1.1.2027.Hos oss får du som skolpsykolog genomföra individuellt och generellt inriktad elevvård mångsidigt och kreativt med det antal elever som är i enlighet med personaldimensioneringen (780 elever/skolpsykolog).Vi erbjuder dig:- nära stöd av arbetsplatsen och erfarna kollegor- veckovisa teammöten vid samma bord- regelbunden arbetshandledning- stöd för utbildning- en konkurrenskraftig lönesättning- möjlighet att delvis arbeta på distans- möjlighet att arbeta deltid- som stöd för inledningen av arbetet erbjuder vi planenlig inskolningGod interaktionsförmåga, förmåga att arbeta självständigt och i team samt ett utvecklande och ansvarsfullt arbetssätt är viktiga i genomförandet av arbetet. Behörighetsvillkoret för tjänsten är behörighet som legitimerad psykolog (272/2005). Tjänsteförhållandets villkor och lön fastställs i enlighet med kollektivavtalet för social- och hälsovårdspersonal (SH-avtalet). Arbetstiden är 37 h 45 min. per vecka.Tjänsten söks genom att fylla i en elektronisk ansökning på adressen www.soite.fi/tyopaikat . Vänligen bifoga din CV till din digitala ansökning. Du behöver inte bifoga kopior av examens- och arbetsintyg till din digitala ansökning, men du bör vara beredd på att visa upp dem vid en eventuell intervju.Innan tjänsten tas emot ska den sökande visa upp ett intyg om sin arbetsförmåga utfärdat av en av företagsläkarna för välfärdsområdets personal (inklusive ett narkotikatest). Därtill ska personen som väljs för tjänsten uppvisa ett straffregisterutdrag i enlighet med 6 § mom. 2 i lagen om kontroll av brottslig bakgrund hos personer som arbetar med barn (504/2002). Vid tillsättandet av tjänsten tillämpas en prövotid på sex månader.Mer information ges av ledande skolpsykolog Johanna Puumala, tfn 040 806 5352 och av verksamhetsenhetens ansvariga chef Maarit Biskop tfn 040 806 5151, e-post: förnamn.efternamn(at)soite.fi.Karleby 11.11.2026

jobs.title: Floor sander
jobs.description:
AP Gulv og Farve is a well-established company located in Smørum, providing professional floor treatments to a wide range of customers. We handle everything from floor sanding to painting tasks. Right now, we are looking for 1-2 experienced colleagues to join our floor sanding team and help tackle our project portfolio. If you have experience as a floor sander and are passionate about your work, we can offer you an attractive workplace with a great atmosphere!

About the job:At AP Floor and Paint, you will work with floor sanding, polishing, and finishing of wooden floors, including finishing with oil, lye, and soap. You will be paired with a colleague, so there are always two of you on tasks, but for small jobs, you can expect to work independently.

As a pair, you will be provided with a company car along with the necessary machines and tools.

We expect that you: 1. Have at least 1 year of experience in floor sanding 2. Have a driver's license B 3. Are responsible and can communicate clearly in English or Danish 4. Complete tasks neatly and with quality in mind We offer: 1. Attractive salary 2. Working hours between 07:00-15:00 3. Colleagues you can spar with 4. Exciting and varied tasks Does the position sound interesting, or do you have any questions? You are very welcome to contact us by email at kontakt@apgulvefarve.dk

jobs.title: Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Kuhmoon
jobs.description: **Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle**Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Kuhmossa.Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää avustajia tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa.""Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."**Helpperinä saat:**Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.Lähetä hakemus helpperiksi täältä: https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksiLue lisää Hembystä täältä:https://www.hemby.fi/Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.description: Paikallinen Unna voi tuottaa kotityöpalveluita, sosiaalihuollon tukipalveluita, hoiva- ja kotisairaanhoidon palveluita eri ikäisille sekä lapsiperheiden ja lasten palveluita. Yrityksesi voi tuottaa kaikkia Unna-palveluita tai erikoistua tuottamaan valitsemiasi Unna-palveluita. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen yrittäjämme voi valita oman yritystoimintansa laajuuden ja palveluvalikoiman oman tilanteensa mukaisesti. Kotihoitoalan yrittäjänä voit itse vaikuttaa työsi sisältöön ja tulotasoosi. Tarjoamme sinulle loistavan mahdollisuuden onnistua kotihoitoalan yrittäjänä!Toimintasi tukena:-Toimialan kokenein ketjuhallinto, jonka kanssa on turvallista kasvaa ja menestyä- Valmis konsepti, jota käytät helposti sähköisten käsikirjojen ja ohjeiden kautta-Sähköinen, Kanta-integroitu toiminnanohjausjärjestelmä. Sisältää asiakaslaskutuksen ja palkkahallinnon.- Ketjun toteuttama kattomarkkinointi ja oman markkinointisi tuki sekä valmiit markkinointiaineistot- Kilpailutetut hankintakanavat- Yrityksen perustamisen ohjaus ja intensiivinen alkukoulutus-Kokenut ja ammattitaitoinen ohjaus, neuvonta ja tuki arjessasi-Säännöllinen yrittäjille suunnattu koulutus ja yhteiset tapahtumat-Innovatiivinen ja lämminhenkinen verkosto - Mahdollisuus osallistua ja vaikuttaa Unnan tarinaan kohti menestystäArvostamme:-Mahdollista toimialan koulutusta, esim. sairaanhoitaja, sosionomi, lähihoitaja -Halua ja innostusta toimia Unnan arvojen mukaisesti, ihmistä kuunnellen-Talouden tasapainoa-Suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa-Yrittäjähenkistä ja rohkeaa asennettaUnna-ketju on täysin suomalainen ja yksityisomisteinen kotihoidon ketju, jonka toiminta perustuu vahvasti arvoista lähtevään tekemiseen ja ihmisten väliseen vuorovaikutukseen. jobs.title: Vi søker asfaltarbeidere / We are hiring asphaltworkers
jobs.description:
Asfaltarbeider søkes

Vi søker dyktige og arbeidsvillige asfaltarbeidere til oppdrag hos våre kunder innen bygg- og anleggsbransjen. Som asfaltarbeider vil du bli en del av et profesjonelt team som jobber med asfaltlegging og tilhørende anleggsarbeid.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Asfaltlegging og utførelse av asfaltarbeid
  • Forberedelse og klargjøring av arbeidsområdet
  • Manuell håndtering og utlegging av asfalt
  • Bruk av relevant utstyr og håndverktøy
  • Komprimering og etterarbeid
  • Følge HMS-rutiner og krav på arbeidsplassen
  • Samarbeide tett med bas, maskinførere og øvrige kollegaer
Vi ser etter deg som
  • Har erfaring fra asfaltarbeid eller annet relevant anleggsarbeid
  • Er arbeidsom, pålitelig og punktlig
  • Trives med fysisk arbeid og høyt arbeidstempo
  • Kan arbeide både selvstendig og i team
  • Har fokus på kvalitet og HMS
  • Har førerkort klasse B – en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav
  • Kommuniserer godt på norsk eller engelsk

Erfaring med asfaltmaskin, vals eller annet relevant anleggsutstyr er en fordel.

Vi tilbyr
  • Spennende oppdrag hos seriøse kunder
  • Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser
  • Mulighet for videre arbeid og nye oppdrag
  • Et godt og profesjonelt arbeidsmiljø
  • Oppfølging fra vår bemanningskonsulent gjennom hele oppdraget
  • Mulighet for å bygge videre på din erfaring innen bygg og anlegg
Arbeidssted

Oppdragene vil være hos våre kunder på ulike prosjekter. Det kan derfor være aktuelt med arbeid på forskjellige lokasjoner.

 

 

 

Asphalt Workers Wanted –

We are looking for skilled and hardworking asphalt workers for assignments with our clients in the construction and civil engineering industry. As an asphalt worker, you will become part of a professional team working with asphalt paving and related construction work.

Main Responsibilities
  • Asphalt paving and general asphalt work
  • Preparing and clearing the work area
  • Manual handling and laying of asphalt
  • Operating relevant tools and equipment
  • Compaction and finishing work
  • Following HSE/health and safety procedures
  • Working closely with supervisors, machine operators and other team members
We Are Looking For Someone Who
  • Has experience with asphalt work or relevant construction/civil engineering work
  • Is hardworking, reliable and punctual
  • Is comfortable with physically demanding work and a fast-paced environment
  • Can work independently as well as part of a team
  • Takes quality and health & safety seriously
  • Holds a Category B driving licence – an advantage, but not a requirement
  • Speaks and understands Norwegian or English

Experience operating asphalt pavers, rollers or other relevant construction equipment is an advantage.

We Offer
  • Exciting assignments with reputable clients
  • Competitive salary and working conditions
  • Opportunities for continued work and future assignments
  • A professional and positive working environment
  • Follow-up and support from our staffing consultant throughout the assignment
  • Opportunities to develop your experience within construction and civil engineering
Location

Assignments will be carried out at various customer projects and locations. Travel between different worksites may therefore be required.

jobs.title: Daglig leder
jobs.description:
Vi søker ny daglig lederVil du lede og videreutvikle Høyanger Bustadstifting?Etter 20 år som daglig leder går vår nåværende leder over i pensjonistenes rekker. Vi søker derfor en ny daglig leder som ønsker å ta ansvar for den videre utviklingen av Høyanger Bustadstifting.Høyanger Bustadstifting eier og forvalter ca. 19 000 m² bygningsmasse i Høyanger kommune, hovedsakelig utleid til offentlig sektor. Vi er 6 ansatte som arbeider med utleie, drift, forvaltning og vedlikehold av våre eiendommer.Som daglig leder får du en sentral rolle i en liten organisasjon, med korte beslutningsveier og stor mulighet til å påvirke hvordan vi utvikler og tar vare på eiendommene våre.Dine viktigste oppgaverSom daglig leder vil du ha det overordnede ansvaret for den daglige driften av stiftinga. Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet omfatte:
  • Ledelse og oppfølging av medarbeidere
  • Overordnet ansvar for økonomi, budsjett og rapportering
  • Forvaltning, drift og vedlikehold av stiftingas eiendommer
  • Planlegging og oppfølging av vedlikeholds- og byggeprosjekter
  • Oppfølging av leverandører, avtaler og innkjøp
  • Kontakt og samarbeid med leietakere og andre samarbeidspartnere
  • Saksforberedelse og rapportering til styret
  • Bidra til videre utvikling av stiftinga og eiendomsporteføljen
  • Tett samarbeid med styret
Hvem ser vi etter?Vi ønsker oss en daglig leder som kombinerer ledererfaring med teknisk forståelse. Relevant teknisk utdanning eller erfaring fra bygg, eiendom, drift, vedlikehold eller tilsvarende vil være en klar fordel.Du bør være strukturert og selvstendig, samtidig som du trives med å arbeide tett sammen med både ansatte, styret, kunder og samarbeidspartnere.Vi legger særlig vekt på at du:
  • Har relevant ledererfaring
  • Har god teknisk forståelse, gjerne innen bygg og eiendom
  • Har økonomisk forståelse og evne til å styre etter budsjett
  • Er løsningsorientert og har god gjennomføringsevne
  • Kommuniserer godt både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner
  • Er tillitsskapende og har evne til å bygge og vedlikeholde gode relasjoner med våre kunder og samarbeidspartnere
Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.Vi tilbyrHos oss får du en selvstendig og variert lederstilling med stor påvirkningsmulighet og ansvar for en betydelig eiendomsmasse.Vi tilbyr blant annet:
  • En interessant lederstilling med stor grad av selvstendighet
  • Et godt og stabilt arbeidsmiljø
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver innen ledelse, eiendom og teknisk drift
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

jobs.title: KRANMEKANIKER TIL SAWO I KØGE
jobs.description:
Kan du finde fejlen i en kran, få den løst og sende kunden sikkert videre? Vi søger en erfaren mekaniker, der kender sit håndværk.

Bliv vores nye kranmekaniker i Køge

SAWO i Køge søger en kollega med solid praktisk erfaring inden for service og reparation af kraner eller tilsvarende hydraulisk materiel. Du bliver en del af et værksted, hvor teknisk nysgerrighed og ordentligt håndværk gør en forskel for kunder, der er afhængige af, at deres udstyr virker.

Du får varierede opgaver og ansvar for at følge dem til dørs sammen med dygtige kolleger. Her er der brug for én, som kan tage fat fra første dag og samtidig har lyst til at lære SAWOs produkter grundigt at kende.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • udføre service, vedligeholdelse og reparation af lastbilmonterede kraner og beslægtet udstyr

  • fejlfinde systematisk på hydraulik, el og mekanik

  • udskifte og tilpasse komponenter samt teste og kvalitetssikre det færdige arbejde

  • dokumentere opgaverne og samarbejde med kolleger om den bedste løsning

  • bidrage til, at kunden får en driftssikker løsning og en god oplevelse

Fra fejl til driftssikker løsning

Fejlfinding → reparation → test → aflevering

Nogle fejl er ligetil. Andre kræver erfaring, tålmodighed og evnen til at se sammenhængen mellem hydraulik, el og mekanik. Du får plads til at bruge din faglighed og sparre med kolleger, når opgaven kræver flere øjne.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Erfaring er et krav. Du har arbejdet professionelt med kraner eller tilsvarende hydrauliske maskiner og kan selvstændigt udføre fejlfinding og reparation. Din uddannelse kan eksempelvis være som lastvognsmekaniker, entreprenørmaskinmekaniker, landbrugsmaskinmekaniker eller en anden relevant teknisk uddannelse. Om du har lært faget ad en anden vej, er mindre vigtigt end det, du kan i praksis.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

  • har solid forståelse for hydraulik og mekanik samt erfaring med elektrisk fejlfinding

  • arbejder grundigt, sikkert og tager ansvar for kvaliteten

  • kan planlægge dine opgaver og bevare overblikket, når noget driller

  • trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og faglig sparring

  • møder kunder og kolleger med en hjælpsom og professionel tilgang

Derfor skal du vælge SAWO

  • En varieret hverdag med teknisk krævende opgaver og ansvar

  • Et fagligt miljø, hvor du kan sparre med erfarne kolleger

  • En bred produktportefølje og mulighed for at udvikle din specialviden

  • Frihed under ansvar og fokus på ordentligt håndværk

  • Ansættelsesvilkår, der aftales efter kvalifikationer

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte, medbringertrucks og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Siden 1962 har vi skabt driftssikre og skræddersyede løsninger. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed, stærkt engagement og respekt for kundens forretning. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.

Klar til næste skridt?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Værkstedschef, Klæmint Christensen, kch@sawo.dk. Har du spørgsmål, kan du kontakte Klæmint Christensen på 27747626.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.description: Akutmottagningen är den enda öppna jourpunkten 24/7 och vi tar emot ca 10.000 patientbesök per år inom alla akutspecialiteter. Vi söker dej med längre erfarenhet som sjukskötare. Meriterande är erfarenhet av arbete inom akutsjukvård under de senaste åren. Stor vikt sätts på personliga egenskaper, där du som person är självgående och strukturerad. Behörighetskrav för tjänsten är legitimerad sjukskötare (FFS 559/94). Behörigheten ska vara registrerad i Tillstånds- och tillsynsverket för social- och hälsovården.Uppgiften kräver vaccinationsskydd i enlighet med 48 § i Lag om smittsamma sjukdomar (FFS 1227/2016).Arbetsspråket är svenska.Tjänsten är ordinarie med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Prövotid kan tillämpas.Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 25.11.2026 kl 15.00.Vi undanber oss vänligen direktkontakt av bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

jobs.title: Global Mobility Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Imagine being the person who makes a move across the world feel easy. A candidate in Sydney gets a visa on a timeline they can plan around. A teammate relocating to Tokyo has a clear playbook, a human to talk to, and nothing to chase. A leader opening a brand-new market has a partner who can map the laws, entities, and employment models.



That's the job. At Notion, we build tools that change how people work together, no matter where they are. As our Global Mobility Manager, you'll build the bridges that make that true for our own team: immigration, relocation, and global expansion, all in one program that you shape, own, and scale.



This is a rare chance to take a working foundation, with playbooks, policies, and vendors already in place, and elevate it. You'll shape the policies and run the cases. You'll partner with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax, with dotted-line support from our shared services model in People Operations, so you're building alongside a team, not on an island. And you'll use AI and automation to turn a historically manual, paper-heavy function into something elegant. If you love fast-moving environments and turning solid foundations into great systems, you'll feel at home here.



This role is based in San Francisco or New York. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own mobility, end to end
   
   - Own immigration and relocation across hiring, transfers, rotations, and assignments, backed by clear policies and playbooks
   
   - Shorten time-to-visa and time-to-move through streamlined intake, approvals, SLAs, and vendor management
   
   - Guide candidates, employees, and managers with empathetic, concise communication and self-serve resources
   
   Power global expansion
   
   - Support our expansion into new markets by:
     
     - Researching and ensuring compliance with local employment laws and regulations
     
     - Partnering with Legal and Finance to establish new state registrations, entity structures, and employment models
     
     - Helping general managers and People Partners design the strategy and program for talent mobility into new markets
   
   Build the partnerships and the program
   
   - Build deep partnerships with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax to ship complex immigration and relocation cases quickly and compliantly
   
   - Be a mobility thought partner and help shape our internal mobility strategy
   
   - Benchmark our policies against internal feedback and external market standards, and spot opportunities to improve
   
   Make it visible and make it automatic
   
   - Build dashboards that show volume, cycle time, cost per move, tax exposure, and compliance posture
   
   - Use technology, AI, and system integrations to eliminate manual work and automate routine tasks




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You have 6–8+ years in global mobility, immigration, or international HR, across multiple regions

 - You've built and scaled a global mobility strategy that supports cross-border talent

 - You've owned a program end to end: policy design, vendor selection, and measurable outcomes in fast-paced environments

 - You know mobility tax well: shadow payroll, equity implications, and permanent establishment risk

 - You have a systems mindset and are comfortable using AI and automation to remove manual work safely

 - You're comfortable with the compliance side of expansion: local employment law, entity setup, and employment models

 - You have excellent judgment and discretion, and your writing is concise enough to help partners move fast

 - You take ownership and run with it. You have real agency: you spot what needs to happen, act with urgency, and drive it to done without waiting to be asked

 - You know how to influence leaders. You bring data, a clear point of view, and a recommendation to senior stakeholders and help them make fast, confident decisions on mobility and expansion

 - You're direct and kind. You have strong opinions, loosely held, and you like to collaborate

 - Bonus: you've supported a company through its first international expansions or entities



Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If you're a builder at heart, share our values, and get excited about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $174,000 - $200,000.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Coach APAC
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

  • Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

  • Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

  • Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

  • Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

  • Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

Who are you?

You areâ¦

  • A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

  • Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

  • Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

  • A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

  • Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

  • Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

  • Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

Other details

  • This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

  • You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

  • You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

  • This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

  • Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there.

Inclusion Statement:
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the requirements.

La figura entrerà a far parte della Direzione ICT e avrà la responsabilità di supervisionare e rafforzare la sicurezza informatica aziendale, contribuendo alla protezione di infrastrutture, sistemi e dati. Principali responsabilità Gestire sistemi, servizi e prodotti di cybersecurity e collaborare con le funzioni ICT per definire configurazioni sicure di apparati, servizi, sistemi e soluzioni. Applicare le procedure aziendali in materia di Qualità, Privacy e Compliance, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali scostamenti o irregolarità alle funzioni competenti. Progettare, implementare, verificare e documentare policy e procedure per proteggere l'infrastruttura informatica da minacce e violazioni della sicurezza. Implementare processi interni ed esterni di Vulnerability Assessment e monitorare l'efficacia dei controlli adottati. Individuare le vulnerabilità e coordinare le opportune azioni di remediation, tutelando la sicurezza della rete e dei dati. Sviluppare e attuare un piano almeno triennale per la messa in sicurezza dei sistemi informativi aziendali. Monitorare l'utilizzo dei sistemi ICT per verificarne la conformità alle policy di sicurezza. Mantenersi aggiornato/a sugli standard di sicurezza IT e sull'evoluzione delle minacce. Documentare le violazioni di sicurezza, valutarne gli impatti e sottoporre le evidenze agli organi competenti. Promuovere presso i colleghi dei Sistemi Informativi le migliori pratiche per la protezione delle informazioni. Organizzare il supporto del service desk per le tematiche di cybersecurity. Predisporre report periodici sullo stato della sicurezza aziendale per la Direzione ICT e il Board. Requisiti ed esperienza Esperienza di almeno 6-7 anni in ambito cybersecurity, maturata nella gestione tecnica di sistemi, servizi e soluzioni di sicurezza. Conoscenza approfondita di sistemi, servizi e prodotti di cybersecurity. Capacità di integrare e automatizzare soluzioni di sicurezza. Esperienza nella gestione tecnica di sistemi di cybersecurity, tra cui Identity Management, sicurezza e configurazione di rete, sistemi di monitoraggio, firewall e reverse proxy. Conoscenza delle principali normative e degli standard di settore, tra cui NIS2, GDPR, MDR, NIST e ISO. Capacità di collaborare efficacemente con team IT/OT e con le diverse funzioni aziendali. jobs.description: Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro (Aut. Min. 26/11/04 Prot. N. 1101-SG), Multinazionale Italiana Leader nei Servizi per le Risorse Umane con oltre 200 filiali sul territorio nazionale e più di 1800 professionisti nel settore delle Risorse Umane, Ricerca per conto di Cineca Consorzio Interuniversitario Data Specialist Cineca è una delle realtà di riferimento in Italia e in Europa per supercalcolo, innovazione digitale e servizi tecnologici avanzati. Per rafforzare il team, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Data Specialist che contribuisca alla gestione, analisi e valorizzazione dei dati aziendali, con particolare riferimento agli ambiti di contabilità e controllo di gestione, supportando la realizzazione di soluzioni di Analytics e Data Platform e l'evoluzione dei relativi flussi e piattaforme dati. Il ruolo: Entrerai in un team che lavora sul dato lungo tutto il suo ciclo di vita, dalla trasformazione alla visualizzazione, con un focus specifico sugli ambiti amministrativi e di controllo. Non si tratta di un ruolo orientato esclusivamente alla reportistica descrittiva: cerchiamo una figura capace di interpretare il dato, valorizzarlo e contribuire anche ad analisi evolute e simulazioni, diventando un punto di riferimento per il proprio perimetro. Ti occuperai di: gestire, trasformare e valorizzare i dati a supporto degli ambiti di contabilità e controllo di gestione; supportare la realizzazione di soluzioni di Analytics e Data Platform; contribuire alla costruzione e all'evoluzione di flussi dati su Data Lake e Data Warehouse; sviluppare dashboard e strumenti di visualizzazione per la lettura e l'utilizzo del dato; contribuire ad analisi evolute e modelli previsionali a supporto delle esigenze di business; collaborare con il team tecnico e con gli stakeholder di riferimento per l'evoluzione dei flussi e delle piattaforme dati. Cerchiamo una persona con almeno 2 anni di esperienza in ambito Analytics e Big Data, maturata su tematiche di contabilità e controllo di gestione. Sono inoltre importanti: Diploma o laurea in ambito scientifico, informatico, statistico o affine; buona conoscenza di SQL e Python; familiarità con linguaggi come Scala e R; esperienza nella costruzione di flussi su Data Lake su DWH; conoscenza di strumenti di Data Visualization e BI, come Power BI e Pentaho; familiarità con librerie per lo sviluppo di modelli e analisi avanzate, come Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, e con approcci di AI/ML; conoscenza di almeno un linguaggio di scripting, come Bash o PowerShell; esperienza con pratiche di CI/CD; conoscenza di Git per versionamento del codice, branching e merging; familiarità con architetture Big Data e ambienti cloud, come Azure, AWS, GCP, o con tecnologie di data processing come Spark / Databricks; capacità di problem solving; attitudine al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione; buone capacità comunicative e relazionali. jobs.description: Wyser ricerca per conto di azienda del settore metalmeccanico, produttrice di macchine/impianti settore dewatering, un Export Area Manager (Europa Occidentale e Nord Europa) Missione del ruolo Sviluppare il business export nei Paesi assegnati, ampliando la rete distributiva e incrementando vendite e marginalità di pompe e soluzioni di drenaggio, con focus su clienti finali pubblici e privati. Gestire il business export già acquisito, attraverso monitoraggio dei Clienti attivi, organizzazione di visite di relazione ed aggiornamento, presenza ad eventi e fiere locali in partnership con il dealer di riferimento. Aree assegnate: Portogallo, Spagna, Francia, Paesi Bassi, Paesi Nordici, Germania, Austria. Settore/divisione: Soluzioni di pompaggio. Responsabilità principali Sviluppo commerciale e pipeline: definire e implementare il piano di sviluppo per i mercati assegnati (target, canali, pricing, forecast). Gestione canali: ricercare, selezionare e gestire distributori, dealer, rental company e partner tecnici; negoziare accordi commerciali e piani di sell-in/sell-out. Vendita consulenziale: gestire trattative complesse su prodotti e soluzioni (pompe, accessori, motorizzazioni, sistemi di adescamento, logistica e messa in servizio), identificando la configurazione tecnica più adatta. Tender e gare: supportare/gestire opportunità su gare pubbliche e richieste strutturate (capitolati, documentazione tecnica, conformità, tempi di consegna). Coordinamento interno: interfacciarsi con ufficio tecnico, operations, supply chain e post-vendita per garantire fattibilità, tempi, qualità e gestione delle priorità (anche in situazioni emergenziali). Market intelligence: monitorare competitor, trend di mercato, normative locali e requisiti di certificazione; proporre azioni di miglioramento prodotto/offerta. Customer relationship management: presidiare clienti strategici, visite periodiche, demo e test sul campo; gestione reclami e escalation in sinergia con service. Reporting: aggiornare CRM, reportistica su performance, forecast e KPI; gestione budget e marginalità per area. Requisiti Esperienza di 4-7+ anni in ruoli export/area sales su mercati europei, preferibilmente in macchinari/elettromeccanica, soluzioni per drenaggio, generatori, attrezzature per cantieri, prodotti tecnici affini. Solida capacità di gestione rete distributiva e negoziazione contratti (scontistica, listini, condizioni, target). Preferenziale familiarità con gare/tender e processi di acquisto strutturati (pubblici o grandi account). Approccio tecnico-commerciale. Disponibilità a viaggiare nei Paesi assegnati (indicativamente 30-50%). Ottime doti relazionali, orientamento a obiettivi, autonomia e capacità di lavorare per priorità (anche in contesti urgenti). Lingue Inglese fluente (C1). Spagnolo fluente e/o Tedesco fluente (una seconda lingua europea è un plus importante). Titolo di studio Diploma tecnico o Laurea (Ingegneria/area tecnica o Economia): preferibile ma non vincolante a fronte di esperienza coerente. Offerta Inserimento in azienda industriale in crescita. Pacchetto retributivo competitivo + variabile su obiettivi ( Range retributivo 45.000-60.000; Liv Impiegatizio, CCNL Metalmeccanico). Auto ad uso promiscuo, strumenti di lavoro, rimborso spese e policy trasferte. Percorso di onboarding tecnico (prodotto, applicazioni, test e training). Riporti Direzione commerciale. Sede di lavoro: Veneto orientale, provincia di Treviso. Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. jobs.title: SPECIJALIST ZA AUTOMATIKU I ELEKTRONIKU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar a u skladu sa Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Ivan Bašić, dipl. ing. el. objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto: Specijalist za automatiku i elektroniku

(broj izvršitelja 1)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Zahtijevana kvalifikacija: VŠS (viša stručna sprema) — završen preddiplomski studij, 180 do 240 ECTS bodova — elektrotehničkog smjera; Razine: 6.st., 6.sv. - Elektrotehničkog/elektroinženjerskog usmjerenja (automatika, elektronika, robotika ili srodni smjer)

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 2 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima; iskustvo sa SCADA/PLC sustavima prednost

Vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Napredno korištenje računala (MS Office, AutoCAD, SCADA/PLC softveri);

Ostali zahtjevi radnog mjesta:

poznavanje engleskog jezika; komunikacijske i analitičke vještine; poznavanje SCADA sustava

Plaća: Visina plaće utvrdit će se unutar pripadajućeg platnog razreda, ovisno o stručnimkvalifikacijama, radnom iskustvu, kompetencijama i drugim objektivnim kriterijima, sukladno važećim internim aktima Društva; Kandidati će prije pristupanja razgovoru biti obaviješteni o pripadajućem platnom razredu i predviđenom rasponu bruto plaće za navedeno radno mjesto.

Opis posla:

  • Planiranje, organiziranje, provedba i nadzor radova na održavanju, servisiranju i kalibraciji automatike i elektroničke opreme na vodoopskrbnim objektima i objektima odvodnje;
  • Sudjelovanje u planiranju godišnjeg održavanja opreme za automatiku i elektroniku te izrade godišnjeg plana nabave;
  • Prema potrebi sudjelovanje u pripremi dokumentacije za provedbu nabave za potrebe Službe crpljenja vode/ Odjela održavanja CP;
  • Praćenje provedbe i nadzor nad izvršenjem ugovora;
  • Programiranje i konfiguracija PLC uređaja, frekventnih pretvarača i SCADA sustava;
  • Vođenje i nadziranje periodičnih pregleda i servisa, remonta i drugih radova na opremi za automatiku i elektroniku;
  • Praćenje i evidentiranje stanja opreme za automatiku i elektroniku te izvještavanje rukovoditelja Službe crpljenja vode;
  • Dijagnostika, otklanjanje kvarova i servisiranje SCADA/PLC sustava, relejne zaštite i upravljačkih ormara;
  • Izrada, revizija i ažuriranje tehničke dokumentacije iz područja elektroopreme i automatike;
  • Priprema objekata za pregled od strane Ex-agencije (oprema u eksplozivnoj zoni);
  • Prikupljanje i analiza podataka o radu vodospremišta i crpnih postaja putem SCADA sustava;
  • Predlaganje mjera za povećanje pouzdanosti i učinkovitosti vodospremišta i crpnih postaja;
  • Predlaganje poboljšanja u radu, rješavanje problema i iznalaženje novih tehničkih rješenja;
  • Osposobljavanje i upute za rad ostalim zaposlenicima Službe crpljenja vode/ Odjela održavanja CP s automatskom opremom;

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme – preslika diplome;
  3. Elektronički zapis o radnopravnom statusu iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (HZMO), ne stariji od šest mjeseci;
  4. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije – preslika važeće vozačke dozvole;
  5. Dokaz o poznavanju engleskog jezika – potvrda, certifikat, vlastoručno potpisana izjava kandidata ili druga odgovarajuća isprava.

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o

profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo

prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o

civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata provest će se putem usmenog razgovora (intervjua), tijekom kojeg će se procjenjivati osnovna i napredna stručna znanja iz područja elektrotehnike, automatike i elektronike, poznavanje SCADA i PLC sustava, sposobnost dijagnosticiranja i otklanjanja tehničkih kvarova, poznavanje rada s elektroničkom i upravljačkom opremom te analitičke, organizacijske i komunikacijske vještine potrebne za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka, u svrhu provođenja odabira kandidata. Sa dostavljenom dokumentacijom raspolažemo u skladu s Izjavom o zaštiti osobnih podataka objavljenoj na web stranici Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr /

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Specijalist za automatiku i elektroniku „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/

Rok za predaju prijava je 19.11.2026. godine.

Prijave koje ne ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja, koje su pristigle van roka za predaju ili koje su nepotpune neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o ishodu javnog natječaja.

Vodovod d.o.o. Zadar pridržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u cijelosti ili djelomično u svakoj fazi postupka, bez obveze navođenja razloga.

The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.What you bring:- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. Leveraging Siemens’ expertise, resources, and its ecosystem of businesses and partners, customers are empowered to unlock the full potential of Siemens technologies. Siemens Advanta elevates customer engagements to an enterprise level, leading transformations through strategic insight and holistic solutions. With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. With this, Siemens Advanta develops repeatable, scalable and proven solutions that maximize customer value across the entire value chain. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Siemens Advanta operates through a global network of around 800 employees across 18 countries.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.de/careers) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (http://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/karrieren-entdecken.html)  – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.title: Energisk og faglig dygtig social og sundhedshjælpere søges til dagvagt.
jobs.description:
Lev-Vel er en af Danmarks største private hjemmeplejevirksomheder. Siden 2007 har vi leveret omsorg, tryghed og høj faglighed til borgere i Lolland-, Faxe-, Vordingborg-, Guldborgsund- og Næstved Kommune.

I dag er vi mere end 200 engagerede medarbejdere, og vi vækster fortsat. Derfor søger vi nu flere dygtige Social og sundhedshjælpere til vores afdeling i Faxe Kommune.

Hos Lev-Vel tror vi på, at stabile relationer skaber den bedste pleje. Vi prioriterer derfor kontinuitet, nærvær og høj kvalitet i mødet med borgeren. Vores mål er enkelt: Borgerne skal have det bedre, når vi går, end da vi kom.

Vi hjælper borgere med både personlig pleje, praktisk hjælp samt private tilkøbsydelser – altid med respekt for den enkelte borgers ønsker og behov.

jobs.title: Make Things Happen: We’re Hiring a Contract Manager Who Loves Action!
jobs.description:
Do you love the buzz of a fast-moving environment where you get real responsibility and make an impact from day one? Do you want to join a team of bold, curious and driven people who are building something extraordinary together? Does negotiating excite you? Then you might just be the Contract Manager we are looking for.

About us

Since 1981, Delta of Scandinavia has been crafting unforgettable travel experiences across the Nordics, from the magic of Iceland’s northern lights to the timeless beauty of Norway’s fjords. Luxury escapes, wild adventures, sustainable journeys: all designed with passion, creativity and a true love for the North.

What do we offer

Join a young, international team where ideas travel fast and every day feels different.

Work in a vibrant environment that inspires creativity, collaboration and fun.

Grow fast, with real career opportunities and intense hands-on training that will boost your skills from day one.

Your responsibilities

As Contract Manager you negotiate and manage our supplier agreements, securing the best commercial conditions and building strong partnerships. Your work supports product quality, operational efficiency and our wider company objectives.

You will be involved in many exciting areas, including:

•      Identify, collect, analyse and negotiate a wide variety of contracts with suppliers. Optimise every agreement to maximise value and keep Delta competitive.

•      Ensure that all contractual terms align with company standards and objectives.

•      Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with suppliers, and act as the main point of contact for contractual matters.

•      Foster collaboration with suppliers to improve product quality and commercial outcomes.

•      Troubleshoot contract-related issues.

•      Make sure that booking procedures with suppliers work well, and identify and implement solutions that improve processes and efficiency.

•      Be in contact with the Department Managers to establish the strategy for the product and stay aware of the departments’ needs.

•      Contribute insights that support product strategy and development.

•      Collaborate with destination partners to stay up to date on product knowledge and market developments, and make sure Delta is involved in the strategies of the Tourist Boards and DMOs, including invitations to events and FAM trips.

•      Keep the communication about the product flowing between staff at all times: exchange news and keep a regular update.

What we expect from you

You bring an exceptional work ethic and a strong sense of urgency. You are driven by ambition and always push yourself to reach the highest standards. You take full ownership of your work, and you are proactive, reliable and committed to delivering results. At the same time, you stay humble and share our enthusiasm for creating and growing new ventures.

We love working from the office: it is where teamwork, creativity and growth truly thrive, when we are together in person. From 1 December 2026 our office will be located at Axeltårn: difficult to find a better location in town.

jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas. Otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. jobs.title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
jobs.description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets. Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland. We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

Option to work from home: Yes

Working load, shifts: 0,5
