jobs.title: Experienced forklift driver for cold storage production
jobs.description:
Are you comfortable working at -20°C and have strong forklift skills?

We are currently looking for an experienced and reliable forklift driver to drive the forklift in a cold storage production, handling fresh and frozen poultry products.

You will be working in a storage facility with temperatures around -20°C, and it is important that you are comfortable working in a cold environment throughout your shift. We are looking for someone who thrives in these conditions and understands the importance of maintaining both safety and efficiency while working in cold temperatures.

The warehouse has narrow aisles and limited operating space, making forklift experience essential. Precision, awareness, and safe operation are critical to success in this role.

Your Responsibilities

  • Receiving fresh poultry products from production

  • Transporting fresh products into the freezer for freezing

  • Moving frozen products throughout the warehouse using a forklift

  • Preparing products for shipment and distribution

  • Handling shipping documents, labels, and product identification

  • Ensuring correct traceability and documentation

  • Maintaining order and cleanliness throughout the freezer warehouse

  • Assisting with daily warehouse and logistics operations

  • Following all food safety, quality, and safety procedures

We Are Looking For Someone Who

  • Holds a valid forklift certificate/license

  • Has solid forklift driving experience from warehouse, logistics, or production companies.

  • Is comfortable working in temperatures of approximately -20°C

  • Thrives in a cold working environment and can maintain a high level of performance throughout the day

  • Has experience operating forklifts in narrow aisles and confined spaces

  • Understands the importance of safe and accurate forklift operation

  • Works independently and takes responsibility for assigned tasks

  • Is structured, quality-conscious, and reliable

  • Has experience working with shipping documents, labels, and warehouse procedures

  • Takes pride in keeping the warehouse organized and efficient

Working Hours

  • Monday to Thursday: Start at 08:35 AM and work until all scheduled tasks are completed

  • Every 6th & 7th Friday: Start at 08:35 AM

  • 37 hours a week, overtime should be expected.

We Offer

  • A stable full-time position in a growing company

  • Long-term employment opportunities

  • A professional and supportive working environment

  • An important role within the warehouse and logistics operation

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

  • Immediate start for the right candidate

Location: Horsens, orsensDenmarkStart Date: As soon as possibleEmployment Type: Full-TimeSalary: Based on qualifications and experience

Apply Today

If you are an experienced forklift driver who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and can thrive in a -20°C freezer, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today, remember to upload your CV. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Employees for fish production in 6855 Outrup
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a stable job within fish production and enjoy hands-on work in a fast-paced and professional production environment? Do you have experience from the fish or food industry and take pride in delivering high-quality work? If so, we would like to hear from you.

We are currently looking for reliable and motivated employees to join a well-established fish production company. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of an international workplace where teamwork, quality, and food safety are highly valued.

Your daily tasks may include:

  • Sorting, processing, and preparing fish products

  • Filleting, trimming, and cutting fish

  • Quality control and inspection of products

  • Weighing, packing, and labeling finished products

  • Cleaning and sanitizing production areas and equipment

  • Assisting with various other production-related tasks as needed

Working Hours

Full-time position, 37 hours per week. Overtime may occur during busy periods.

Day Shift: 06:55 - 15:09Morning Shift: 05:55 - 14:09

Please note that there is a 1-hour self-paid break each day.

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Speak and understand English

  • Are physically fit and comfortable performing standing and repetitive work

  • Have previous experience from fish production, food production, or a similar manufacturing environment

  • Can work efficiently while maintaining a high level of quality

  • Are able to follow strict hygiene, safety, and quality procedures

  • Are reliable, punctual, and have a positive attitude towards teamwork

 

What We Offer

  • A good and supportive working environment with colleagues from many different nationalities

  • Thorough introduction and training

  • Workwear and safety footwear provided by the company

  • Access to a canteen with the option to purchase food

  • The opportunity to gain valuable experience within a professional food production company

Salary: 143,40,- + 6,50,- per hour.

Important Information

Due to the location of the workplace and the early working hours, public transportation is not a realistic option, and it is therefore necessary that you have your own reliable means of transportation to and from work.

Due to strict hygiene and food safety requirements, jewelry, piercings, artificial nails, and artificial eyelashes are not permitted in the production area.

If you are looking for long-term employment in a professional production environment and have experience from the fish or food industry, we encourage you to apply. We are looking for employees who are ready to contribute, work as part of a team, and help maintain the high standards our customer is known for.

Interested? We conduct ongoing interviews and look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC to play a key role in enhancing our sales productivity in our APAC region. This role will design, deliver, and continuously improve sales onboarding for our new hires. You will work closely with sales leadership, enablement, and product marketing to ensure our field salesforce is equipped with the skills, tools, and knowledge needed to achieve revenue targets and drive customer success.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead APAC Sales & Success onboarding by facilitating Notion’s Sales Bootcamp for new hires across the region

 - Own the APAC Onboarding Calendar end-to-end, ensuring a consistent, well-sequenced new-hire experience

 - Establish a clear communication cadence with APAC frontline leaders, setting expectations and ensuring visibility into each new hire’s onboarding plan and progress

 - Partner with APAC Sales Leadership, Enablement and Revenue Operations to iterate on and deliver high-impact live sessions with clear objectives and strong SME alignment that is aligned to the global program and tailored for regional nuances (Korea, Japan, and APACx)

 - Operationalize the pre-work, certifications, and continued learning path so assignments land at the right time and reinforce on-the-job performance

 - Measure onboarding effectiveness through qualitative inputs (e.g., surveys), and translate insights into clear recommendations and iteration plans

 Manual testing:

-         Experience using JIRA / Confluence is an asset
-         Intermediate SQL level
-         Previous experience testing PKI/Banking/Mobile/Web applications
-         Experienced in QA with ISEB/ISTQB certification or similar experience
-         Experience in test design, risk management, defect management with a strong background in security
-         Solid knowledge of manual and automated software testing
-         Experience writing test documentation

Languages: French and English fluent. Any other language is an asset.

Technical / Specific skills:

-         Expected to be able to liaise with developers and assess their test automated scripts
-         Comfortable working in a fast paced Agile environment
-         Analytical mindset
-         Proactive and positive attitude with good Team-spirit
-         Good interpersonal relations and communications skills (written and oral)
-         Good time management and priority setting skills
-         Good at corner cases tests methodology
-          Ability to write or understand Bash, HTML/XML, SQL, JavaScript<>TypeScript, Java
-         Hands-on experience testing on the main software platforms: Web, Windows, Linux, iOS, OSX, Android

-         Corner case testing mindset
-         Automation expertise

Core competencies at LuxTrust:

jobs.title: Senior Staff Infrastructure & Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CIVILGRID

CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer.

Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain-of-custody documentation. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running.

We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for.

WHY THIS ROLE

We're looking for a Security & Infrastructure Engineer to own our security posture and assist in supporting our cloud platform and reliability as we scale into large utilities and civil engineering firms. You'll take over and grow our security program, working across engineering, IT, and leadership. The role is on the Systems team that spans DevOps, SRE, and security. Your focus is security but you will contribute across the team.

This role reports to the Head of Engineering. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our Boston, MA office at least 3 days per week if hired.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with engineering to embed reliability and security into the SDLC and infrastructure decisions

  • Run our security program: SOC 2 readiness and audits, vendor reviews, access controls, endpoint security, and threat modeling

  • Define and enforce policies for identity, secrets, data handling, and production access across the company

  • Lead incident response for both security events, and some reliability events, from detection through resolution and follow-up

  • Harden and monitor our GIS servers (Windows Server) alongside our AWS platform

  • Build and maintain our Trust Center, and lead security reviews with customers

  • Contribute to our AWS environment end to end: VPC architecture, ECS, RDS, secrets management, IAM, networking, and cost optimization

  • Contribute to improving reliability practices: SLOs, observability, alerting, on-call rotation, runbooks, and blameless post-incident reviews

  • The tech:

    • AWS ECS, Postgres on RDS managed with CDK

    • GitHub, Datadog, Slack, Notion, Drata

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • At least 5-8 years of experience across product security, platform security, or security engineering, with hands-on experience with DevOps or SRE of production AWS infrastructure

  • Experience running or supporting a SOC 2 program, including evidence collection, control design, and auditor coordination

  • Deep working knowledge of AWS (VPC, ECS, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent)

  • Experience running vulnerability management, from scanner findings and outside reports to fixes shipped

  • Track record of improving reliability in production: defining SLOs, building observability, running on-call, and leading post-incident reviews

  • Startup ready: autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked

  • Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience supporting B2B products sold into regulated industries (utilities, energy, public sector)

HOW WE WORK

We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers â huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in-person collaboration where it matters and remote-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

The base salary range for this role is $137,318 - $192,960.

Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location.

In addition to base and equity, we offer:

  • Company-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance â including medical plans at no cost to the employee

  • FSA (health and dependent care)

  • Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment

  • A high-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us â we're happy to help.

TMT d.o.o. Čakovec traži iskusnog i odgovornog djelatnika/djelatnicu za radno mjesto Plinski ravnač/plinska ravnačica – specijalist/specijalistica za toplinsko ravnanje metalnih dijelova i konstrukcija. Mjesto rada: Lepoglava Opis poslova:
  • Ravnanje metalnih dijelova i zavarenih čeličnih konstrukcija kontroliranim zagrijavanjem plinskim plamenikom
  • Uklanjanje deformacija nastalih tijekom zavarivanja i drugih proizvodnih procesa

Uvjeti:
  • Iskustvo u plinskom (toplinskom) ravnanju metalnih dijelova i metalnih konstrukcija
  • Poznavanje postupaka ravnanja metalnih dijelova nakon zavarivanja
  • Sposobnost čitanja tehničkih crteža
  • Samostalnost, preciznost i odgovornost u radu
  • Iskustvo u metaloprerađivačkoj industriji
Nudimo:
  • Stabilno zaposlenje u proizvodnoj tvrtki
  • Redovita primanja
  • Rad u profesionalnom proizvodnom okruženju
  • Mogućnost dugoročnog zaposlenja i profesionalnog razvoja

Ako imate iskustva u toplinskom ravnanju metalnih dijelova i konstrukcija i želite raditi u stabilnoj proizvodnoj tvrtki, pozivamo vas da nam se pridružite.

FLAME STRAIGHTENING SPECIALIST – STEEL STRUCTURES TMT d.o.o. Čakovec is looking for an experienced and responsible Flame Straightening Specialist to join our production team. Work Location: Lepoglava, Croatia Job Responsibilities

  • Straightening metal components and welded steel structures using controlled heating with gas torches.
  • Correcting distortions and deformations caused by welding and other manufacturing processes.
  • Performing manual and mechanical straightening using appropriate tools, fixtures, and hydraulic presses.
  • Checking straightness, dimensions, and tolerances according to technical drawings and specifications.
  • Independently determining heating locations, sequences, and intensity to achieve the required geometry of steel structures.

Requirements
  • Proven experience in flame straightening (thermal straightening) of metal components and steel structures.
  • Knowledge of techniques for correcting welding-induced distortions.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
  • Ability to work independently with precision, reliability, and responsibility.
  • Previous experience in the metalworking or steel fabrication industry.
What We Offer
  • Stable employment in an established manufacturing company.
  • Accomodation
  • Food allowance
  • Regular and reliable salary payments.
  • Professional and well-equipped production environment.
  • Opportunities for long-term employment and professional development.
  • All necessary tools, equipment, and protective gear provided.

APPLY NOW! If you have experience in flame straightening, heat straightening, or correcting distortions in welded steel structures and are looking for a stable, long-term position, we invite you to join our team at TMT d.o.o. Join our team in Lepoglava, Croatia!

jobs.title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
jobs.description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Applications close on Monday 16 November 2026, 23:59 CET.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.

Important: To show that you have read this post, include the word Validator in your answer to the question "Why Claims" in the application form.



Please mention the word **WINNABLE** and tag RMy40Mi4xNTcuNTQ= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMy40Mi4xNTcuNTQ=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

The Job

Your main responsibilities will include picking and packing orders, unloading shipping containers and preparing pallets for dispatch, as well as other general warehouse duties.

jobs.title: PhD scholarship in Experimental Clearance Flow Research - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
The PhD candidate will, as part of a collaboration project between a private enterprise and DTU Construct, carry out experimental clearance flow research with ammonia and other sustainable marine fuels. Pressure and temperature conditions, resembling those in a marine engine booster pump, are created in an in-house designed clearance flow test rig. Measured clearance flow data will be used to develop and validate accurate flow models. The test rig will be further modified to enable testing and evaluation of different sealing solutions.Responsibilities and qualificationsThe PhD candidate will be responsible for continuing our development of a high-pressure ammonia flow rig, conduct test campaigns with different ammonia pump components and develop both theoretical and experimental foundation for developing ammonia compatible sealing techniques.The candidate should have significant experience with:
  • Safe handling of ammonia and other liquified gases in test setups.
  • Design and wiring electronic data acquisition and control systems using PC Schematics.
  • LabView programming.
  • Mechanical design and FEM analysis using Solid Works.
  • Data processing of large experimental sets of dynamic flow and pressure data using statistical methods in Matlab.
  • CMM (Coordinate Measurement Machine) measurement and preferably have experience with Calypso Software.
  • Data processing large complex geometric data sets from CMM measurements for 3-dimensional analysis of tested pump components.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and EnrolmentThe scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 January 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Anders Ivarsson, aniv@dtu.dk.You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedureYour complete online application must be submitted no later than 19 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
  • A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.title: Underviser i robotteknologi til Absalons ingeniør-uddannelser - genopslag
jobs.description:
Click for version in English Vil du være med til at opbygge en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi? Brænder du for at udvikle en ny uddannelse i tæt samarbejde med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, studerende og lokale virksomheder? Så kan det være dig, vi står og mangler til vores studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved efter- og videreuddannelsen i Automation og Drift. På Absalon får du mulighed for at kombinere din erfaring fra robot-, automations- eller maskinområdet med undervisning. Samtidig sætter du dit faglige aftryk på uddannelsens indhold, laboratorier og samarbejde med industrien. Absalon etablerer i september 2027 en ny engelsksproget diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi. Uddannelsen har fokus på integration af robot- og automationsløsninger og en forståelse for helheden i det produktionssystem, hvor løsningen skal indgå. Diplomingeniøruddannelse i robotteknologi indgår i tæt sammenhæng med diplomingeniøruddannelsen i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelsen på akademiniveau i Automation og Drift. På ingeniøruddannelserne er det vores ambition at uddanne de bedste ingeniører i Danmark. Vi målretter vores uddannelse til arbejdsmarkedet ved at samarbejde tæt med den danske automations-, maskin- og procesindustri samt virksomheder og andre aktører i Biotekbyen Kalundborg og i Campus Kalundborgsamarbejdet. Læs meget mere her. https://www.biotekbyen.dk/ Din profil Vi søger en underviser, der brænder for at uddanne inden for grænseområdet mellem robotteknologi, automation, produktionsstyring og maskinteknologi. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i nedenstående: Dygtig og motiverende underviser, der er engageret i de studerende. Du bidrager sammen med dine kolleger til at skabe et aktivt, fagligt og socialt studiemiljø. Det er vigtigt, at du kan bidrage positivt til den nære faglige relation, vi har mellem undervisere og studerende. Medvirker til at få det faglige, det praktiske og samarbejdet til at fungere godt. Vi er mere end en arbejdsplads, og du skal ligesom os, være drevet af et stærkt kammeratskab og en fælles faglig interesse. Du sparrer med din kolleger omkring din undervisning, og sammen finder vi løsninger på praktiske opgaver. Du har desuden nemt ved at indgå i dialog med virksomheder, både i forhold til muligheder for efter- og videreuddannelse og hvad angår samarbejde med studerende på diplomingeniøruddannelserne. Du har lyst til at indgå i et arbejdsfællesskab og være med til at etablere en ny uddannelse. Vi opbygger og udvikler løbende vores ingeniøruddannelser, og meget skal gøres for første gang. Du får en central rolle i beskrivelsen og opbygningen af den nye uddannelse i robotteknologi og automation. Du skal bl.a. være med til at indrette og skaffe det rette udstyr til kommende robot- og automationslaboratorier. Din ingeniørfaglighed kommer i spil når du skal undervise, vejlede og sparrer med kolleger inden for dele af følgende områder:
  • Integration og programmering af industrirobotter, f.eks. Universal robots, ABB, KUKA, FANUC
  • Industri 4.0
  • Siemens TIA-portal
  • Industrielle netværk
  • Vision-systemer og sensorteknologi
  • Sikkerhedssystemer og cyber security
  • CE-mærkning og gældende standarder for fagområdet
  • Integration af AI i robot- og automationsløsninger
  • PLC-, HMI- og SCADA-løsninger
  • CAD og 3D print
Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har en baggrund som ingeniør, det kan f.eks. være robot-/automationsingeniør, produktionsingeniør, elektroingeniør, maskiningeniør eller lignende
  • har relevant erhvervserfaring inden for ingeniørfaget
  • kan undervise på engelsk og gerne også på dansk
  • gerne er lektorbedømt
  • har indsigt i industriens behov for ingeniørkompetencer inden for robot og automationsområdet. Det er ikke et krav, men vil det være en fordel.
Dine arbejdsopgaver Som underviser på diplomingeniøruddannelserne og ved Automation og Drift har du en række forskellige opgaver i løbet af en arbejdsuge. Opbygge en uddannelse. Du har interesse i at spille en central rolle i etablering af ny uddannelse inden for robotteknologi og eventuelt have en koordinerende rolle i beskrivelse af uddannelsen, udarbejdelse af studieordning, etablering af studenter-, og virksomhedsnetværk samt indkøb af udstyr og indretning af laboratorium. Har du erfaring med og interesse i enkelte administrative opgaver vil det være en fordel. Undervise og projektvejlede studerende. Du skal primært undervise og vejlede vores studerende både teoretisk og laboratorie- og projektbaseret inden for dine fagområder. Du skal selv tilrettelægge, gennemføre og evaluere undervisningen. Du skal også være med til løbende at udvikle vores undervisning. Undervise på efter- og videreuddannelse (EVU) og på grunduddannelse. Du skal undervise studerende på fuldtidsstudium såvel som kursister med et fuldtidsarbejde ved siden af deres uddannelse på EVU. Til undervisningen på EVU kan der også være opgaver med opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder og præsentation af uddannelsesudbud. Fagligt samarbejde som en del af hverdagen. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du sparrer og samarbejder med dine kolleger. Sammen sørger I f.eks. for at tilrettelægge gode undervisningsforløb, udvikle undervisningsmaterialer, og måske er der et arrangement tilknyttet centret, som skal stables på benene. Undervisningen på de forskellige uddannelsesudbud vil fortrinsvis være på vores Campus Kalundborg, men på EVU-området kan der forekomme undervisning på Absalons campus i Roskilde. Du skal være forberedt på, at noget undervisning kan foregå i weekend eller på aftener. Dine kolleger Du bliver ansat i Centre for Engineering and Science, som driver uddannelserne Bioanalytiker, Radiograf, Diplomingeniør i bioteknologi, Diplomingeniør i maskinteknologi samt efter- og videreuddannelserne Diplomuddannelse i bioteknologi, Procesteknologi og kemi, Akademiuddannelse i Automation og Drift samt Akademiuddannelse i Innovation, produkt og produktion. Du bliver en del af et team med uddannelsesleder, adjunkter og lektorer. På vores ingeniøruddannelser i Kalundborg er vi ca. 20 ansatte undervisere. Vi arbejder på at skabe den bedste ingeniøruddannelse i tæt samarbejde med biotekindustrien i Nordvestsjælland, samt vores engagerede studerende. Vi værdsætter høj faglighed og løser opgaver, samt udfordringer i fællesskab, hvor vi alle er bevidste om vigtigheden af at bidrage til fællesskabet og til centrets samlede målsætning. Vi holder til i nybygget campusbygning fra 2021 og i nabobygningen Helix Lab. Absalon er desuden med i Campus Kalundborginitiativet, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen med fem andre uddannelsesinstitutioner, og fra 2028 vil vi være en del af et nyt fælles Campus Kalundborg-byggeri. Der kan blive tale om ansættelse som lektor Du bedes tilkendegive i din ansøgning, hvilken type ansættelse du søger. Sådan ansøger du Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er nyuddannet og ansættes som adjunkt, vil en forventet startløn være 41.232,- kr. inkl. pension.For dig der er en erfaren underviser og ansættes som lektor, vil en forventet startløn være 53.537,- kr. inkl. pension.Der er mulighed for at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse pr. 1. januar 2027, meget gerne før
  • Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesleder Jesper Stensbo Knudsen, jesk@pha.dk, 7248 3224
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger, eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 15. november 2026
  • Vi forventer at afholde samtaler løbende, dog senest i uge 47 og 48.
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. For stillingen gælder det, at du ansættes som adjunkt eller lektor alt efter dine kvalifikationer. På Absalon er adjunkturet en 4-årig uddannelsesstilling. Det understøtter vi gennem Absalons lektorkvalificeringsforløb, som alle nyansatte adjunkter deltager i, og hvor alle får tilknyttet en vejleder. For at blive ansat som lektor forudsætter det en positiv lektorbedømmelse inden for stillingstrukturens anvendelsesområde. Ved ansættelse af lektorer, der er lektorbedømt før 2013-stillingsstrukturen, sker ansættelse på hidtidige centralt fastsatte løn- og ansættelsesvilkår. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer, afvejet med stillingens konkrete indhold, kan fornyet lektorbedømmelse efter den aktuelle stillingsstruktur (fast-track ordningen) eventuelt aftales. Læs mere her i kap. 5: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2020/673 Du kan læse mere om rammerne for ansættelse som adjunkt eller lektor i vores stillingsstruktur her: https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/2021/1458 Om Absalon Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund. Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Rethinking Converter Synchronization: 2-Year Postdoctoral Position in Battery Energy Storage Systems
jobs.description:
Are you eager to contribute to a bold experimental research project at the forefront of power electronics and energy storage? We are offering an exciting 2-year postdoctoral position for a talented researcher to investigate advanced converter synchronization and control methods for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with particular emphasis on exploiting naturally occurring acoustic and vibration information. The project combines converter control, sensing, signal processing, and experimental validation to explore new approaches toward simpler, more robust, and scalable BESS operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of January 2027, or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the projectThe position is affiliated with the VILLUM Experiment project A-choir and the EMI/EMC In Power Electronics research group at AAU Energy. The project investigates new synchronization concepts for multi-converter BESSs by combining power electronics, sensing, signal processing, and control. A particular focus is placed on whether physical signatures naturally generated during converter operation can provide useful information for synchronization and coordination. 

You will join a research environment working across power electronics, EMI/EMC, converter control, multi-physics analysis, and experimental validation with applications including battery energy storage systems and other converter-dominated energy systems, with opportunities for collaboration across disciplines. The position also offers opportunities for international scientific exchange, participation in leading conferences, and may include research visits to relevant academic or industrial partners.

Your work tasksYou will:

  • Develop and investigate synchronization and coordination methods for power electronic converters.
  • Develop sensing and signal-processing methods for acoustic and vibration measurements.
  • Establish and evaluate relationships between physical signatures and converter switching/operating behaviors.
  • Implement and validate the developed methods using real-time control platforms, HIL, and experimental converter setups.
  • Assess the proposed approaches under representative BESS operating conditions, including robustness to interference and multi-converter interactions.
  • Contribute to the coordination of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision in areas related to your expertise.

Your competenciesWe expect you to have:

  • A PhD in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in power electronics, power converter modelling and control, converter synchronization, signal processing, EMI/EMC, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and experimental skills using DSP, MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, hardware-in-the-loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as synchronization and coordination control, digital signal processing, time-frequency analysis, data-driven modelling, or machine learning.
  • Good knowledge of battery storage systems or multi-converter systems; experience with synchronization control, hierarchical control, hardware design, or AI-assisted signal would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be an expert in all technical areas covering power electronics, acoustic/vibration sensing, signal processing, or machine learning. Strong competence in power converter control and synchronization, together with solid experimental skills and the ability to work across sensing, EMI/EMC, and system-level interactions, is particularly important. We value scientific independence, critical thinking, strong experimental skills, and a rigorous approach to modelling, implementation, validation, and documentation.

Who we areThe position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based at the Aalborg campus. Read more at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Postdoc”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.description: C-27001 HEAD OF INTERNAL AUDITPermanent contract | Belval Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join usThe Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ ContextAs the Head of Internal Audit, you will lead, structure and continuously develop LIST's Internal Audit Service, an independent and objective assurance and advisory function serving the Board of Directors through the Finance and Audit Committee.The role provides independent assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control, while supporting compliance with applicable laws and regulations and contributing to the continuous improvement of LIST's organisation and operations.In addition to defining the internal audit strategy and the risk-based annual audit plan, you will oversee the full audit lifecycle, from planning and execution to reporting, follow-up and quality assurance. Your team and environmentYour team - 3 people• Head of Internal Audit - 1 | leadership of the function, audit strategy, governance and stakeholder engagement• Internal Audit collaborators - 2 | contribution to assurance, advisory, audit follow-up and continuous improvement activitiesThe Internal Audit Service operates as an independent function within LIST and coordinates with Risk Management, where relevant, to leverage synergies and avoid duplication of work without prejudice to its independence.You will report to the Chair of the Board of Directors, or to the Vice-Chair in the event of replacement of the Chair, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter. confidentiality and competence• Define and implement the internal audit strategy in alignment with LIST's goals and objectives• Develop, maintain and continuously improve the Internal Audit Charter, policies, methodologies, processes and procedures• Act as a trusted and independent reference for the Board of Directors, Finance and Audit Committee, CEO and Executive Management on governance, risk and internal control matters Risk-Based Audit Planning & Delivery• Identify and prioritise LIST's key risk areas and prepare the annual risk-based internal audit plan for validation by the Finance and Audit Committee and approval by the Board of Directors• Oversee and conduct assurance, advisory and investigation assignments, including complex and specific missions, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter and the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards• Adapt the audit plan and mission work programmes when emerging events or risks require timely action• Ensure audit work is appropriately jobs.title: RADNIK NA ODRŽAVANJU - ELEKTRIČAR(M/Ž)
jobs.description:
O NAMA

Bjelin Ogulin 2 d.o.o. dio je hrvatsko-švedske Bjelin grupacije, jednog od vodećih europskih proizvođača inovativnih drvenih podova. Usmjereni smo na visokotehnološku proizvodnju i razvoj održivih rješenja od drva, spajajući lokalnu stručnost s globalnim standardima kvalitete. Naš tim čine motivirani i stručni profesionalci različitih profila – od proizvodnih i tehničkih do inženjerskih i stručnih administrativnih funkcija – koje povezuje zajednička strast prema inovacijama, kvaliteti i kontinuiranom unapređenju procesa. Trenutno intenzivno ulažemo u izgradnju najsuvremenijeg pogona za proizvodnju podova u Ogulinu te širimo kapacitete kroz nove proizvodne linije za Woodura podne obloge. Paralelno s razvojem proizvodnje, sustavno jačamo organizaciju kroz razvoj tehničkih, logističkih, administrativnih i ostalih ključnih podržavajućih funkcija. U nadolazećem razdoblju fokusirani smo na zapošljavanje, edukaciju i osposobljavanje zaposlenika svih profila, s ciljem osiguravanja visoke razine kvalitete procesa, proizvoda i održivog rasta cijele organizacije.

TVOJI KLJUČNI ZADACI

  • Održavanje i popravak radnih linija, strojeva i pribora,

  • Remont postrojenja,

  • Vođenje brige o elektroopremi,

  • Obavljanje sitnih popravaka i čišćenja elektro dijelova uređaja,

  • Sudjelovanje u demontaži i montaži elektroopreme prilikom redovitih i interventnih servisa i pri otklanjanju kvarova,

  • Praćenje rada uređaja i strojeva, ukazivanje na trenutne probleme i sudjelovanje u otklanjanju istih,

  • Pregled elektroopreme prema uputama (svakodnevno, tjedno, mjesečno) te ažurira iste.

OČEKUJEMO

  • SSS tehničkog ili drugog odgovarajućeg usmjerenja

  • Interes za otkrivanjem i rješavanjem problema

  • Komunikativna ste i organizirana osoba

  • Orijentiran na detalje i pouzdan zaposlenik

  • Profesionalizam, želju za učenjem i uklapanjem u korporativni sustav

  • Spremnost na rad u smjenama

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Poticajno radno okruženje

  • Redovita primanja

  • Mjesečni dodatak za prehranu

  • Djelomično pokriveni troškovi prijevoza

  • Mjesečna nagrada za radne rezultate

  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno radno vrijeme uz probni rad od 6 mjeseci.

  • Početna plaća (tijekom probnog rada) 1.550€ BRUTO - mogućnost povećanja plaće ovisno o usvojenim znanjima, vještinama i samostalnosti u radu

  • Povećan broj dana godišnjeg odmora s obzirom na jubilarni staž i broj djece do 15 godina starosti

  • Božićnica, uskrsnica, regres, dar za djecu

  • Poklon bon za novorođenče

  • Jubilarne nagrade

  • Jasna mogućnost napredovanja kroz preuzimanje odgovornijih i kompleksnijih zadataka

  • Preuzimanje zanimljivih, izazovnih ali istovremeno zahtjevnih i odgovornih poslovnih zadataka

  • Mogućnost stjecanja novih znanja i osobnog razvoja

  • Sigurno i stabilno radno okruženja

  • Ravnotežu privatnog i poslovnog života

  • Mentorska podrška

  • Svježe voće za zaposlenike

  • Dva besplatna topla napitka dnevno po zaposleniku

  • Mogućnost punjenja električnih automobila (punionica na lokaciji)

  • Osigurana i profesionalno održavana radna odjeća (pranje i zamjena organizirani od strane poslodavca)

  • Bonus za preporuke (kada zaposlenik preporuči novog zaposlenika koji se zaposli)

POČETAK RADA I RADNO VRIJEME

  • Početak rada novih zaposlenika je 1. prosinca 2026.

  • Radi se u turnusima od 12 sati, od ponedjeljka do petka, uz rotaciju tri smjene.

MJESTO OBAVLJANJA POSLA

· Rad na proizvodnoj lokaciji u Ogulinu - Poduzetnička zona

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka u svrhu provođenja selekcijskog postupka.

POTREBNA DOKUMENTACIJA ZA PRIJAVU :

  • životopis,

  • uvjerenja da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (uvjerenje nadležnog suda ne starije od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja)

  • preslika svjedodžbe

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, Eastern/Central Time
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based within U.S. and Canada Eastern or Central Time. You can work from anywhere within those time zones. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

What we're looking for

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

 - Based in U.S. or Canada Eastern or Central Time only.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $95,000—$135,000. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

Learn how we think and work

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - How Linear uses Linear: How our Customer Experience team works in Linear https://linear.app/now/cx-in-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Our recent tender offer: Sharing Linear’s growth with the people building it https://linear.app/now/sharing-growth-with-the-people-building-linear

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will work closely with our enterprise customers and engineers to resolve the most complex issues. You will also help build out systems and processes to manage tasks from report to completion. You will problem solve with our technical teams and work to resolve as much as you can while scaling our systems and support processes.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Resolve customer issues leveraging your technical expertise and act as the primary point of escalation for our external support teams.

 - Reproduce customer issues, perform initial triage and file software defects and feedback with Engineering

 - Work cross-functionally across engineering and product to build processes and manage issues.

 - Develop deep product and platform expertise, diagnose and prevent recurring issues while contributing to feedback loops that improve both product quality and existing workflows.

 - Manage to key performance metrics defined within the CX Team.

 - Create and maintain internal knowledge libraries and contribute to the creation of user-facing content.

 - Should be open to 24/5 shift model and participate in an on-call rotation to assist customers outside of normal working hours.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3-5 years in a support capacity focusing on escalated issue and/or technical troubleshooting. A track record of contributing to performance metrics like customer satisfaction and response time.

 - Exceptional problem-solving skills capable of diagnosing complex technical issues, querying data, and review product logs. You can drive problems to resolution efficiently and effectively.

 - Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners (i.e. Engineering, Product, and Operations) to drive long-term solutions and ensure customer feedback informs product improvements.

 - Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.

 - Experience contributing or owning projects to optimizing processes, workflows, and support operations that drive performance improvements. You have strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills**.** You are capable of distilling complex, technical material to non-technical audiences.

 - Ability to balance user expectations with policies and compliance boundaries. Ability to work under pressure while remaining focused and professional.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Strong analytical skills with a passion for interpreting data to improve decision-making and outcomes.

 - Experience with tools and technologies like Zendesk, SQL databases, APIs, AI tools.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive (London)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



Replit is experiencing extraordinary demand and seeking an Enterprise Account Executive with strong communication skills to drive our hyper-growth. Candidates with SaaS experience, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.



This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

 - Conduct compelling product demonstrations and help realize the art of the possible by orchestrating non-engineering hackathons

 - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business objectives

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and successful delivery

 - Prepare tailored quotes and skillfully negotiate deals

 - Maintain accurate customer and forecasting data in Replit’s CRM (Hubspot)

 - Foster strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for expanded adoption

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing collaboration and support

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience in AE or SE/technical sales role, preferably in SaaS or developer tools

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

 - Experience with, or direct observations of full-cycle sales, from prospecting to closing deals to managing existing customers

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet

 - Self-motivated with excellent time management and organizational skills

 - Passion for technology and staying current with industry trends

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

 - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for client meetings and events
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
   
   


TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Replit

THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence.
